vulg: multifariam et multis modis olim Deus loquens patribus in prophetis
clem: Multifariam, multisque modis olim Deus loquens patribus in prophetis:
tr: πολυμερως και πολυτροπως παλαι ο θεος λαλησας τοις πατρασιν εν τοις προφηταις
kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

vulg: novissime diebus istis locutus est nobis in Filio quem constituit heredem universorum per quem fecit et saecula
clem: novissime, diebus istis locutus est nobis in Filio, quem constituit hredem universorum, per quem fecit et scula:
tr: επ εσχατων των ημερων τουτων ελαλησεν ημιν εν υιω (1:2) ον εθηκεν κληρονομον παντων δι ου και τους αιωνας εποιησεν
kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

vulg: qui cum sit splendor gloriae et figura substantiae eius portansque omnia verbo virtutis suae purgationem peccatorum faciens sedit ad dexteram Maiestatis in excelsis
clem: qui cum sit splendor glori, et figura substanti ejus, portansque omnia verbo virtutis su, purgationem peccatorum faciens, sedet ad dexteram majestatis in excelsis:
tr: ος ων απαυγασμα της δοξης και χαρακτηρ της υποστασεως αυτου φερων τε τα παντα τω ρηματι της δυναμεως αυτου δι εαυτου καθαρισμον ποιησαμενος των αμαρτιων ημων εκαθισεν εν δεξια της μεγαλωσυνης εν υψηλοις
kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:

vulg: tanto melior angelis effectus quanto differentius prae illis nomen hereditavit
clem: tanto melior angelis effectus, quanto differentius pr illis nomen hreditavit.
tr: τοσουτω κρειττων γενομενος των αγγελων οσω διαφορωτερον παρ αυτους κεκληρονομηκεν ονομα
kjv: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

vulg: cui enim dixit aliquando angelorum Filius meus es tu ego hodie genui te et rursum ego ero illi in Patrem et ipse erit mihi in Filium
clem: Cui enim dixit aliquando angelorum: Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te? Et rursum: Ego ero illi in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium?
tr: τινι γαρ ειπεν ποτε των αγγελων υιος μου ει συ εγω σημερον γεγεννηκα σε και παλιν εγω εσομαι αυτω εις πατερα και αυτος εσται μοι εις υιον
kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

vulg: et cum iterum introducit primogenitum in orbem terrae dicit et adorent eum omnes angeli Dei
clem: Et cum iterum introducit primogenitum in orbem terr, dicit: Et adorent eum omnes angeli Dei.
tr: οταν δε παλιν εισαγαγη τον πρωτοτοκον εις την οικουμενην λεγει και προσκυνησατωσαν αυτω παντες αγγελοι θεου
kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

vulg: et ad angelos quidem dicit qui facit angelos suos spiritus et ministros suos flammam ignis
clem: Et ad angelos quidem dicit: Qui facit angelos suos spiritus, et ministros suos flammam ignis.
tr: και προς μεν τους αγγελους λεγει ο ποιων τους αγγελους αυτου πνευματα και τους λειτουργους αυτου πυρος φλογα
kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

vulg: ad Filium autem thronus tuus Deus in saeculum saeculi et virga aequitatis virga regni tui
clem: Ad Filium autem: Thronus tuus Deus in sculum sculi: virga quitatis, virga regni tui.
tr: προς δε τον υιον ο θρονος σου ο θεος εις τον αιωνα του αιωνος ραβδος ευθυτητος η ραβδος της βασιλειας σου
kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

vulg: dilexisti iustitiam et odisti iniquitatem propterea unxit te Deus Deus tuus oleo exultationis prae participibus tuis
clem: Dilexisti justitiam, et odisti iniquitatem: propterea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, oleo exultationis pr participibus tuis.
tr: ηγαπησας δικαιοσυνην και εμισησας ανομιαν δια τουτο εχρισεν σε ο θεος ο θεος σου ελαιον αγαλλιασεως παρα τους μετοχους σου
kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

vulg: et tu in principio Domine terram fundasti et opera manuum tuarum sunt caeli
clem: Et: Tu in principio, Domine, terram fundasti: et opera manuum tuarum sunt cli.
tr: και συ κατ αρχας κυριε την γην εθεμελιωσας και εργα των χειρων σου εισιν οι ουρανοι
kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

vulg: ipsi peribunt tu autem permanebis et omnes ut vestimentum veterescent
clem: Ipsi peribunt, tu autem permanebis, et omnes ut vestimentum veterascent:
tr: αυτοι απολουνται συ δε διαμενεις και παντες ως ιματιον παλαιωθησονται
kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

vulg: et velut amictum involves eos et mutabuntur tu autem idem es et anni tui non deficient
clem: et velut amictum mutabis eos, et mutabuntur: tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non deficient.
tr: και ωσει περιβολαιον ελιξεις αυτους και αλλαγησονται συ δε ο αυτος ει και τα ετη σου ουκ εκλειψουσιν
kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

vulg: ad quem autem angelorum dixit aliquando sede a dextris meis quoadusque ponam inimicos tuos scabillum pedum tuorum
clem: Ad quem autem angelorum dixit aliquando: Sede a dextris meis, quoadusque ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum?
tr: προς τινα δε των αγγελων ειρηκεν ποτε καθου εκ δεξιων μου εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

vulg: nonne omnes sunt administratorii spiritus in ministerium missi propter eos qui hereditatem capient salutis
clem: Nonne omnes sunt administratorii spiritus, in ministerium missi propter eos, qui hreditatem capient salutis?
tr: ουχι παντες εισιν λειτουργικα πνευματα εις διακονιαν αποστελλομενα δια τους μελλοντας κληρονομειν σωτηριαν
kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

vulg: propterea abundantius oportet observare nos ea quae audivimus ne forte pereffluamus
clem: Propterea abundantius oportet observare nos ea qu audivimus, ne forte pereffluamus.
tr: δια τουτο δει περισσοτερως ημας προσεχειν τοις ακουσθεισιν μηποτε παραρρυωμεν
kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

vulg: si enim qui per angelos dictus est sermo factus est firmus et omnis praevaricatio et inoboedientia accepit iustam mercedis retributionem
clem: Si enim qui per angelos dictus est sermo, factus est firmus, et omnis prvaricatio, et inobedientia accepit justam mercedis retributionem:
tr: ει γαρ ο δι αγγελων λαληθεις λογος εγενετο βεβαιος και πασα παραβασις και παρακοη ελαβεν ενδικον μισθαποδοσιαν
kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

vulg: quomodo nos effugiemus si tantam neglexerimus salutem quae cum initium accepisset enarrari per Dominum ab eis qui audierunt in nos confirmata est
clem: quomodo nos effugiemus si tantam neglexerimus salutem? qu cum initium accepisset enarrari per Dominum ab eis, qui audierunt, in nos confirmata est,
tr: πως ημεις εκφευξομεθα τηλικαυτης αμελησαντες σωτηριας ητις αρχην λαβουσα λαλεισθαι δια του κυριου υπο των ακουσαντων εις ημας εβεβαιωθη
kjv: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

vulg: contestante Deo signis et portentis et variis virtutibus et Spiritus Sancti distributionibus secundum suam voluntatem
clem: contestante Deo signis et portentis, et variis virtutibus, et Spiritus Sancti distributionibus secundum suam voluntatem.
tr: συνεπιμαρτυρουντος του θεου σημειοις τε και τερασιν και ποικιλαις δυναμεσιν και πνευματος αγιου μερισμοις κατα την αυτου θελησιν
kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

vulg: non enim angelis subiecit orbem terrae futurum de quo loquimur
clem: Non enim angelis subjecit Deus orbem terr futurum, de quo loquimur.
tr: ου γαρ αγγελοις υπεταξεν την οικουμενην την μελλουσαν περι ης λαλουμεν
kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

vulg: testatus est autem in quodam loco quis dicens quid est homo quod memor es eius aut filius hominis quoniam visitas eum
clem: Testatus est autem in quodam loco quis, dicens: Quid est homo quod memor es ejus, aut filius hominis quoniam visitas eum?
tr: διεμαρτυρατο δε που τις λεγων τι εστιν ανθρωπος οτι μιμνησκη αυτου η υιος ανθρωπου οτι επισκεπτη αυτον
kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man that thou visitest him?

vulg: minuisti eum paulo minus ab angelis gloria et honore coronasti eum et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum
clem: Minuisti eum paulo minus ab angelis: gloria et honore coronasti eum: et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum.
tr: ηλαττωσας αυτον βραχυ τι παρ αγγελους δοξη και τιμη εστεφανωσας αυτον και κατεστησας αυτον επι τα εργα των χειρων σου
kjv: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

vulg: omnia subiecisti sub pedibus eius in eo enim quod ei omnia subiecit nihil dimisit non subiectum ei nunc autem necdum videmus omnia subiecta ei
clem: Omnia subjecisti sub pedibus ejus. In eo enim quod omnia ei subjecit, nihil dimisit non subjectum ei. Nunc autem necdum videmus omnia subjecta ei.
tr: παντα υπεταξας υποκατω των ποδων αυτου εν γαρ τω υποταξαι αυτω τα παντα ουδεν αφηκεν αυτω ανυποτακτον νυν δε ουπω ορωμεν αυτω τα παντα υποτεταγμενα
kjv: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

vulg: eum autem qui modico quam angeli minoratus est videmus Iesum propter passionem mortis gloria et honore coronatum ut gratia Dei pro omnibus gustaret mortem
clem: Eum autem, qui modico quam angeli minoratus est, videmus Jesum propter passionem mortis, gloria et honore coronatum: ut, gratia Dei, pro omnibus gustaret mortem.
tr: τον δε βραχυ τι παρ αγγελους ηλαττωμενον βλεπομεν ιησουν δια το παθημα του θανατου δοξη και τιμη εστεφανωμενον οπως χαριτι θεου υπερ παντος γευσηται θανατου
kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

vulg: decebat enim eum propter quem omnia et per quem omnia qui multos filios in gloriam adduxerat auctorem salutis eorum per passiones consummare
clem: Decebat enim eum, propter quem omnia, et per quem omnia, qui multos filios in gloriam adduxerat, auctorem salutis eorum per passionem consummare.
tr: επρεπεν γαρ αυτω δι ον τα παντα και δι ου τα παντα πολλους υιους εις δοξαν αγαγοντα τον αρχηγον της σωτηριας αυτων δια παθηματων τελειωσαι
kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

vulg: qui enim sanctificat et qui sanctificantur ex uno omnes propter quam causam non confunditur fratres eos vocare dicens
clem: Qui enim sanctificat, et qui sanctificantur, ex uno omnes. Propter quam causam non confunditur fratres eos vocare, dicens:
tr: ο τε γαρ αγιαζων και οι αγιαζομενοι εξ ενος παντες δι ην αιτιαν ουκ επαισχυνεται αδελφους αυτους καλειν
kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

vulg: nuntiabo nomen tuum fratribus meis in medio ecclesiae laudabo te
clem: Nuntiabo nomen tuum fratribus meis: in medio ecclesi laudabo te.
tr: λεγων απαγγελω το ονομα σου τοις αδελφοις μου εν μεσω εκκλησιας υμνησω σε
kjv: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

vulg: et iterum ego ero fidens in eum et iterum ecce ego et pueri mei quos mihi dedit Deus
clem: Et iterum: Ego ero fidens in eum. Et iterum: Ecce ego, et pueri mei, quos dedit mihi Deus.
tr: και παλιν εγω εσομαι πεποιθως επ αυτω και παλιν ιδου εγω και τα παιδια α μοι εδωκεν ο θεος
kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

vulg: quia ergo pueri communicaverunt sanguini et carni et ipse similiter participavit hisdem ut per mortem destrueret eum qui habebat mortis imperium id est diabolum
clem: Quia ergo pueri communicaverunt carni, et sanguini, et ipse similiter participavit eisdem: ut per mortem destrueret eum qui habebat mortis imperium, id est, diabolum:
tr: επει ουν τα παιδια κεκοινωνηκεν σαρκος και αιματος και αυτος παραπλησιως μετεσχεν των αυτων ινα δια του θανατου καταργηση τον το κρατος εχοντα του θανατου τουτ εστιν τον διαβολον
kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

vulg: et liberaret eos qui timore mortis per totam vitam obnoxii erant servituti
clem: et liberaret eos qui timore mortis per totam vitam obnoxii erant servituti.
tr: και απαλλαξη τουτους οσοι φοβω θανατου δια παντος του ζην ενοχοι ησαν δουλειας
kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

vulg: nusquam enim angelos adprehendit sed semen Abrahae adprehendit
clem: Nusquam enim angelos apprehendit, sed semen Abrah apprehendit.
tr: ου γαρ δηπου αγγελων επιλαμβανεται αλλα σπερματος αβρααμ επιλαμβανεται
kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

vulg: unde debuit per omnia fratribus similare ut misericors fieret et fidelis pontifex ad Deum ut repropitiaret delicta populi
clem: Unde debuit per omnia fratribus similari, ut misericors fieret, et fidelis pontifex ad Deum, ut repropitiaret delicta populi.
tr: οθεν ωφειλεν κατα παντα τοις αδελφοις ομοιωθηναι ινα ελεημων γενηται και πιστος αρχιερευς τα προς τον θεον εις το ιλασκεσθαι τας αμαρτιας του λαου
kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

vulg: in eo enim in quo passus est ipse temptatus potens est eis qui temptantur auxiliari
clem: In eo enim, in quo passus est ipse et tentatus, potens est et eis, qui tentantur, auxiliari.
tr: εν ω γαρ πεπονθεν αυτος πειρασθεις δυναται τοις πειραζομενοις βοηθησαι
kjv: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

vulg: unde fratres sancti vocationis caelestis participes considerate apostolum et pontificem confessionis nostrae Iesum
clem: Unde, fratres sancti, vocationis clestis participes, considerate Apostolum, et pontificem confessionis nostr Jesum:
tr: οθεν αδελφοι αγιοι κλησεως επουρανιου μετοχοι κατανοησατε τον αποστολον και αρχιερεα της ομολογιας ημων χριστον ιησουν
kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

vulg: qui fidelis est ei qui fecit illum sicut et Moses in omni domo illius
clem: qui fidelis est ei, qui fecit illum, sicut et Moyses in omni domo ejus.
tr: πιστον οντα τω ποιησαντι αυτον ως και μωσης εν ολω τω οικω αυτου
kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

vulg: amplioris enim gloriae iste prae Mose dignus habitus est quanto ampliorem honorem habet domus qui fabricavit illam
clem: Amplioris enim glori iste pr Moyse dignus est habitus, quanto ampliorem honorem habet domus, qui fabricavit illam.
tr: πλειονος γαρ δοξης ουτος παρα μωσην ηξιωται καθ οσον πλειονα τιμην εχει του οικου ο κατασκευασας αυτον
kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

vulg: omnis namque domus fabricatur ab aliquo qui autem omnia creavit Deus
clem: Omnis namque domus fabricatur ab aliquo: qui autem omnia creavit, Deus est.
tr: πας γαρ οικος κατασκευαζεται υπο τινος ο δε τα παντα κατασκευασας θεος
kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

vulg: et Moses quidem fidelis erat in tota domo eius tamquam famulus in testimonium eorum quae dicenda erant
clem: Et Moyses quidem fidelis erat in tota domo ejus tamquam famulus, in testimonium eorum, qu dicenda erant:
tr: και μωσης μεν πιστος εν ολω τω οικω αυτου ως θεραπων εις μαρτυριον των λαληθησομενων
kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

vulg: Christus vero tamquam filius in domo sua quae domus sumus nos si fiduciam et gloriam spei usque ad finem firmam retineamus
clem: Christus vero tamquam filius in domo sua: qu domus sumus nos, si fiduciam, et gloriam spei usque ad finem, firmam retineamus.
tr: χριστος δε ως υιος επι τον οικον αυτου ου οικος εσμεν ημεις εανπερ 0 την παρρησιαν και το καυχημα της ελπιδος μεχρι τελους βεβαιαν κατασχωμεν
kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

vulg: quapropter sicut dicit Spiritus Sanctus hodie si vocem eius audieritis
clem: Quapropter sicut dicit Spiritus Sanctus: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis,
tr: διο καθως λεγει το πνευμα το αγιον σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε
kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

vulg: nolite obdurare corda vestra sicut in exacerbatione secundum diem temptationis in deserto
clem: nolite obdurare corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatione secundum diem tentationis in deserto,
tr: μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων ως εν τω παραπικρασμω κατα την ημεραν του πειρασμου εν τη ερημω
kjv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

vulg: ubi temptaverunt me patres vestri probaverunt et viderunt opera mea
clem: ubi tentaverunt me patres vestri: probaverunt, et viderunt opera mea
tr: ου επειρασαν με οι πατερες υμων εδοκιμασαν με και ειδον τα εργα μου τεσσαρακοντα ετη
kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

vulg: quadraginta annos propter quod infensus fui generationi huic et dixi semper errant corde ipsi autem non cognoverunt vias meas
clem: quadraginta annis: propter quod infensus fui generationi huic, et dixi: Semper errant corde. Ipsi autem non cognoverunt vias meas,
tr: διο προσωχθισα τη γενεα εκεινη και ειπον αει πλανωνται τη καρδια αυτοι δε ουκ εγνωσαν τας οδους μου
kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

vulg: sicut iuravi in ira mea si introibunt in requiem meam
clem: sicut juravi in ira mea: Si introibunt in requiem meam.
tr: ως ωμοσα εν τη οργη μου ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου
kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

vulg: videte fratres ne forte sit in aliquo vestrum cor malum incredulitatis discedendi a Deo vivo
clem: Videte fratres, ne forte sit in aliquo vestrum cor malum incredulitatis, discedendi a Deo vivo:
tr: βλεπετε αδελφοι μηποτε εσται εν τινι υμων καρδια πονηρα απιστιας εν τω αποστηναι απο θεου ζωντος
kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

vulg: sed adhortamini vosmet ipsos per singulos dies donec hodie cognominatur ut non obduretur quis ex vobis fallacia peccati
clem: sed adhortamini vosmetipsos per singulos dies, donec hodie cognominatur, ut non obduretur quis ex vobis fallacia peccati.
tr: αλλα παρακαλειτε εαυτους καθ εκαστην ημεραν αχρις ου το σημερον καλειται ινα μη σκληρυνθη τις εξ υμων απατη της αμαρτιας
kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

vulg: participes enim Christi effecti sumus si tamen initium substantiae usque ad finem firmum retineamus
clem: Participes enim Christi effecti sumus, si tamen initium substanti ejus usque ad finem firmum retineamus.
tr: μετοχοι γαρ γεγοναμεν του χριστου εανπερ 0 την αρχην της υποστασεως μεχρι τελους βεβαιαν κατασχωμεν
kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

vulg: dum dicitur hodie si vocem eius audieritis nolite obdurare corda vestra quemadmodum in illa exacerbatione
clem: Dum dicitur: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra, quemadmodum in illa exacerbatione.
tr: εν τω λεγεσθαι σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων ως εν τω παραπικρασμω
kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

vulg: quidam enim audientes exacerbaverunt sed non universi qui profecti sunt ab Aegypto per Mosen
clem: Quidam enim audientes exacerbaverunt: sed non universi qui profecti sunt ex gypto per Moysen.
tr: τινες γαρ ακουσαντες παρεπικραναν αλλ ου παντες οι εξελθοντες εξ αιγυπτου δια μωσεως
kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

vulg: quibus autem infensus est quadraginta annos nonne illis qui peccaverunt quorum cadavera prostrata sunt in deserto
clem: Quibus autem infensus est quadraginta annis? nonne illis qui peccaverunt, quorum cadavera prostrata sunt in deserto?
tr: τισιν δε προσωχθισεν τεσσαρακοντα ετη ουχι τοις αμαρτησασιν ων τα κωλα επεσεν εν τη ερημω
kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

vulg: quibus autem iuravit non introire in requiem ipsius nisi illis qui increduli fuerunt
clem: Quibus autem juravit non introire in requiem ipsius, nisi illis qui increduli fuerunt?
tr: τισιν δε ωμοσεν μη εισελευσεσθαι εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου ει μη τοις απειθησασιν
kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

vulg: et videmus quia non potuerunt introire propter incredulitatem
clem: Et videmus, quia non potuerunt introire propter incredulitatem.
tr: και βλεπομεν οτι ουκ ηδυνηθησαν εισελθειν δι απιστιαν
kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

vulg: timeamus ergo ne forte relicta pollicitatione introeundi in requiem eius existimetur aliqui ex vobis deesse
clem: Timeamus ergo ne forte relicta pollicitatione introundi in requiem ejus, existimetur aliquis ex vobis deesse.
tr: φοβηθωμεν ουν μηποτε καταλειπομενης επαγγελιας εισελθειν εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου δοκη τις εξ υμων υστερηκεναι
kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

vulg: etenim et nobis nuntiatum est quemadmodum et illis sed non profuit illis sermo auditus non admixtis fidei ex his quae audierunt
clem: Etenim et nobis nuntiatum est, quemadmodum et illis: sed non profuit illis sermo auditus, non admistus fidei ex iis qu audierunt.
tr: και γαρ εσμεν ευηγγελισμενοι καθαπερ κακεινοι αλλ ουκ ωφελησεν ο λογος της ακοης εκεινους μη συγκεκραμενος τη πιστει τοις ακουσασιν
kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

vulg: ingrediemur enim in requiem qui credidimus quemadmodum dixit sicut iuravi in ira mea si introibunt in requiem meam et quidem operibus ab institutione mundi factis
clem: Ingrediemur enim in requiem, qui credidimus: quemadmodum dixit: Sicut juravi in ira mea: Si introibunt in requiem meam: et quidem operibus ab institutione mundi perfectis.
tr: εισερχομεθα γαρ εις την καταπαυσιν οι πιστευσαντες καθως ειρηκεν ως ωμοσα εν τη οργη μου ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου καιτοι των εργων απο καταβολης κοσμου γενηθεντων
kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

vulg: dixit enim quodam loco de die septima sic et requievit Deus die septima ab omnibus operibus suis
clem: Dixit enim in quodam loco de die septima sic: Et requievit Deus die septima ab omnibus operibus suis.
tr: ειρηκεν γαρ που περι της εβδομης ουτως και κατεπαυσεν ο θεος εν τη ημερα τη εβδομη απο παντων των εργων αυτου
kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

vulg: et in isto rursum si introibunt in requiem meam
clem: Et in isto rursum: Si introibunt in requiem meam.
tr: και εν τουτω παλιν ει εισελευσονται εις την καταπαυσιν μου
kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

vulg: quoniam ergo superest quosdam introire in illam et hii quibus prioribus adnuntiatum est non introierunt propter incredulitatem
clem: Quoniam ergo superest introire quosdam in illam, et ii, quibus prioribus annuntiatum est, non introierunt propter incredulitatem:
tr: επει ουν απολειπεται τινας εισελθειν εις αυτην και οι προτερον ευαγγελισθεντες ουκ εισηλθον δι απειθειαν
kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

vulg: iterum terminat diem quendam hodie in David dicendo post tantum temporis sicut supra dictum est hodie si vocem eius audieritis nolite obdurare corda vestra
clem: iterum terminat diem quemdam, Hodie, in David dicendo, post tantum temporis, sicut supra dictum est: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra.
tr: παλιν τινα οριζει ημεραν σημερον εν δαβιδ λεγων μετα τοσουτον χρονον καθως ειρηται σημερον εαν της φωνης αυτου ακουσητε μη σκληρυνητε τας καρδιας υμων
kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

vulg: nam si eis Iesus requiem praestitisset numquam de alio loqueretur posthac die
clem: Nam si eis Jesus requiem prstitisset, numquam de alia loqueretur, posthac, die.
tr: ει γαρ αυτους ιησους κατεπαυσεν ουκ αν περι αλλης ελαλει μετα ταυτα ημερας
kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

vulg: itaque relinquitur sabbatismus populo Dei
clem: Itaque relinquitur sabbatismus populo Dei.
tr: αρα απολειπεται σαββατισμος τω λαω του θεου
kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

vulg: qui enim ingressus est in requiem eius etiam ipse requievit ab operibus suis sicut a suis Deus
clem: Qui enim ingressus est in requiem ejus, etiam ipse requievit ab operibus suis, sicut a suis Deus.
tr: ο γαρ εισελθων εις την καταπαυσιν αυτου και αυτος κατεπαυσεν απο των εργων αυτου ωσπερ απο των ιδιων ο θεος
kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

vulg: festinemus ergo ingredi in illam requiem ut ne in id ipsum quis incidat incredulitatis exemplum
clem: Festinemus ergo ingredi in illam requiem: ut ne in idipsum quis incidat incredulitatis exemplum.
tr: σπουδασωμεν ουν εισελθειν εις εκεινην την καταπαυσιν ινα μη εν τω αυτω τις υποδειγματι πεση της απειθειας
kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

vulg: vivus est enim Dei sermo et efficax et penetrabilior omni gladio ancipiti et pertingens usque ad divisionem animae ac spiritus conpagum quoque et medullarum et discretor cogitationum et intentionum cordis
clem: Vivus est enim sermo Dei, et efficax et penetrabilior omni gladio ancipiti: et pertingens usque ad divisionem anim ac spiritus: compagum quoque ac medullarum, et discretor cogitationum et intentionum cordis.
tr: ζων γαρ ο λογος του θεου και ενεργης και τομωτερος υπερ πασαν μαχαιραν διστομον και διικνουμενος αχρι μερισμου ψυχης τε και πνευματος αρμων τε και μυελων και κριτικος ενθυμησεων και εννοιων καρδιας
kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

vulg: et non est ulla creatura invisibilis in conspectu eius omnia autem nuda et aperta sunt oculis eius ad quem nobis sermo
clem: Et non est ulla creatura invisibilis in conspectu ejus: omnia autem nuda et aperta sunt oculis ejus, ad quem nobis sermo.
tr: και ουκ εστιν κτισις αφανης ενωπιον αυτου παντα δε γυμνα και τετραχηλισμενα τοις οφθαλμοις αυτου προς ον ημιν ο λογος
kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

vulg: habentes ergo pontificem magnum qui penetraverit caelos Iesum Filium Dei teneamus confessionem
clem: Habentes ergo pontificem magnum qui penetravit clos, Jesum Filium Dei, teneamus confessionem.
tr: εχοντες ουν αρχιερεα μεγαν διεληλυθοτα τους ουρανους ιησουν τον υιον του θεου κρατωμεν της ομολογιας
kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

vulg: non enim habemus pontificem qui non possit conpati infirmitatibus nostris temptatum autem per omnia pro similitudine absque peccato
clem: Non enim habemus pontificem qui non possit compati infirmitatibus nostris: tentatum autem per omnia pro similitudine absque peccato.
tr: ου γαρ εχομεν αρχιερεα μη δυναμενον συμπαθησαι ταις ασθενειαις ημων πεπειραμενον  πεπειρασμενον  δε κατα παντα καθ ομοιοτητα χωρις αμαρτιας
kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

vulg: adeamus ergo cum fiducia ad thronum gratiae ut misericordiam consequamur et gratiam inveniamus in auxilio oportuno
clem: Adeamus ergo cum fiducia ad thronum grati: ut misericordiam consequamur, et gratiam inveniamus in auxilio opportuno.
tr: προσερχωμεθα ουν μετα παρρησιας τω θρονω της χαριτος ινα λαβωμεν ελεον και χαριν ευρωμεν εις ευκαιρον βοηθειαν
kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

vulg: omnis namque pontifex ex hominibus adsumptus pro hominibus constituitur in his quae sunt ad Deum ut offerat dona et sacrificia pro peccatis
clem: Omnis namque pontifex ex hominibus assumptus, pro hominibus constituitur in iis qu sunt ad Deum, ut offerat dona, et sacrificia pro peccatis:
tr: πας γαρ αρχιερευς εξ ανθρωπων λαμβανομενος υπερ ανθρωπων καθισταται τα προς τον θεον ινα προσφερη δωρα τε και θυσιας υπερ αμαρτιων
kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

vulg: qui condolere possit his qui ignorant et errant quoniam et ipse circumdatus est infirmitate
clem: qui condolere possit iis qui ignorant et errant: quoniam et ipse circumdatus est infirmitate:
tr: μετριοπαθειν δυναμενος τοις αγνοουσιν και πλανωμενοις επει και αυτος περικειται ασθενειαν
kjv: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

vulg: et propter eam debet quemadmodum et pro populo ita etiam pro semet ipso offerre pro peccatis
clem: et propterea debet, quemadmodum pro populo, ita etiam et pro semetipso offerre pro peccatis.
tr: και δια ταυτην οφειλει καθως περι του λαου ουτως και περι εαυτου προσφερειν υπερ αμαρτιων
kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

vulg: nec quisquam sumit sibi honorem sed qui vocatur a Deo tamquam Aaron
clem: Nec quisquam sumit sibi honorem, sed qui vocatur a Deo, tamquam Aaron.
tr: και ουχ εαυτω τις λαμβανει την τιμην αλλα ο καλουμενος υπο του θεου καθαπερ και ο ααρων
kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

vulg: sic et Christus non semet ipsum clarificavit ut pontifex fieret sed qui locutus est ad eum Filius meus es tu ego hodie genui te
clem: Sic et Christus non semetipsum clarificavit ut pontifex fieret: sed qui locutus est ad eum: Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te.
tr: ουτως και ο χριστος ουχ εαυτον εδοξασεν γενηθηναι αρχιερεα αλλ ο λαλησας προς αυτον υιος μου ει συ εγω σημερον γεγεννηκα σε
kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

vulg: quemadmodum et in alio dicit tu es sacerdos in aeternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech
clem: Quemadmodum et in alio loco dicit: Tu es sacerdos in ternum, secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
tr: καθως και εν ετερω λεγει συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
kjv: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

vulg: qui in diebus carnis suae preces supplicationesque ad eum qui possit salvum illum a morte facere cum clamore valido et lacrimis offerens et exauditus pro sua reverentia
clem: Qui in diebus carnis su preces, supplicationesque ad eum qui possit illum salvum facere a morte cum clamore valido, et lacrimis offerens, exauditus est pro sua reverentia.
tr: ος εν ταις ημεραις της σαρκος αυτου δεησεις τε και ικετηριας προς τον δυναμενον σωζειν αυτον εκ θανατου μετα κραυγης ισχυρας και δακρυων προσενεγκας και εισακουσθεις απο της ευλαβειας
kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

vulg: et quidem cum esset Filius didicit ex his quae passus est oboedientiam
clem: Et quidem cum esset Filius Dei, didicit ex iis, qu passus est, obedientiam:
tr: καιπερ ων υιος εμαθεν αφ ων επαθεν την υπακοην
kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

vulg: et consummatus factus est omnibus obtemperantibus sibi causa salutis aeternae
clem: et consummatus, factus est omnibus obtemperantibus sibi, causa salutis tern,
tr: και τελειωθεις εγενετο τοις υπακουουσιν αυτω πασιν αιτιος σωτηριας αιωνιου
kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

vulg: appellatus a Deo pontifex iuxta ordinem Melchisedech
clem: appellatus a Deo pontifex juxta ordinem Melchisedech.
tr: προσαγορευθεις υπο του θεου αρχιερευς κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

vulg: de quo grandis nobis sermo et ininterpretabilis ad dicendum quoniam inbecilles facti estis ad audiendum
clem: De quo nobis grandis sermo, et ininterpretabilis ad dicendum: quoniam imbecilles facti estis ad audiendum.
tr: περι ου πολυς ημιν ο λογος και δυσερμηνευτος λεγειν επει νωθροι γεγονατε ταις ακοαις
kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

vulg: etenim cum deberetis magistri esse propter tempus rursum indigetis ut vos doceamini quae sint elementa exordii sermonum Dei et facti estis quibus lacte opus sit non solido cibo
clem: Etenim cum deberetis magistri esse propter tempus, rursum indigetis ut vos doceamini qu sint elementa exordii sermonum Dei: et facti estis quibus lacte opus sit, non solido cibo.
tr: και γαρ οφειλοντες ειναι διδασκαλοι δια τον χρονον παλιν χρειαν εχετε του διδασκειν υμας τινα τα στοιχεια της αρχης των λογιων του θεου και γεγονατε χρειαν εχοντες γαλακτος και ου στερεας τροφης
kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

vulg: omnis enim qui lactis est particeps expers est sermonis iustitiae parvulus enim est
clem: Omnis enim, qui lactis est particeps, expers est sermonis justiti: parvulus enim est.
tr: πας γαρ ο μετεχων γαλακτος απειρος λογου δικαιοσυνης νηπιος γαρ εστιν
kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

vulg: perfectorum autem est solidus cibus eorum qui pro consuetudine exercitatos habent sensus ad discretionem boni ac mali
clem: Perfectorum autem est solidus cibus: eorum, qui pro consuetudine exercitatos habent sensus ad discretionem boni ac mali.
tr: τελειων δε εστιν η στερεα τροφη των δια την εξιν τα αισθητηρια γεγυμνασμενα εχοντων προς διακρισιν καλου τε και κακου
kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

vulg: quapropter intermittentes inchoationis Christi sermonem ad perfectionem feramur non rursum iacientes fundamentum paenitentiae ab operibus mortuis et fidei ad Deum
clem: Quapropter intermittentes inchoationis Christi sermonem, ad perfectiora feramur, non rursum jacientes fundamentum pnitenti ab operibus mortuis, et fidei ad Deum,
tr: διο αφεντες τον της αρχης του χριστου λογον επι την τελειοτητα φερωμεθα μη παλιν θεμελιον καταβαλλομενοι μετανοιας απο νεκρων εργων και πιστεως επι θεον
kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

vulg: baptismatum doctrinae inpositionis quoque manuum ac resurrectionis mortuorum et iudicii aeterni
clem: baptismatum doctrin, impositionis quoque manuum, ac resurrectionis mortuorum, et judicii terni.
tr: βαπτισμων διδαχης επιθεσεως τε χειρων αναστασεως τε νεκρων και κριματος αιωνιου
kjv: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

vulg: et hoc faciemus siquidem permiserit Deus
clem: Et hoc faciemus, si quidem permiserit Deus.
tr: και τουτο ποιησομεν εανπερ 0 επιτρεπη ο θεος
kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.

vulg: inpossibile est enim eos qui semel sunt inluminati gustaverunt etiam donum caeleste et participes sunt facti Spiritus Sancti
clem: Impossibile est enim eos qui semel sunt illuminati, gustaverunt etiam donum cleste, et participes facti sunt Spiritus Sancti,
tr: αδυνατον γαρ τους απαξ φωτισθεντας γευσαμενους τε της δωρεας της επουρανιου και μετοχους γενηθεντας πνευματος αγιου
kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

vulg: gustaverunt nihilominus bonum Dei verbum virtutesque saeculi venturi
clem: gustaverunt nihilominus bonum Dei verbum, virtutesque sculi venturi,
tr: και καλον γευσαμενους θεου ρημα δυναμεις τε μελλοντος αιωνος
kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

vulg: et prolapsi sunt renovari rursus ad paenitentiam rursum crucifigentes sibimet ipsis Filium Dei et ostentui habentes
clem: et prolapsi sunt; rursus renovari ad pnitentiam, rursum crucifigentes sibimetipsis Filium Dei, et ostentui habentes.
tr: και παραπεσοντας παλιν ανακαινιζειν εις μετανοιαν ανασταυρουντας εαυτοις τον υιον του θεου και παραδειγματιζοντας
kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

vulg: terra enim saepe venientem super se bibens imbrem et generans herbam oportunam illis a quibus colitur accipit benedictionem a Deo
clem: Terra enim spe venientem super se bibens imbrem, et generans herbam opportunam illis, a quibus colitur, accipit benedictionem a Deo:
tr: γη γαρ η πιουσα τον επ αυτης πολλακις ερχομενον υετον και τικτουσα βοτανην ευθετον εκεινοις δι ους και γεωργειται μεταλαμβανει ευλογιας απο του θεου
kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

vulg: proferens autem spinas ac tribulos reproba est et maledicto proxima cuius consummatio in conbustionem
clem: proferens autem spinas ac tribulos, reproba est, et maledicto proxima: cujus consummatio in combustionem.
tr: εκφερουσα δε ακανθας και τριβολους αδοκιμος και καταρας εγγυς ης το τελος εις καυσιν
kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

vulg: confidimus autem de vobis dilectissimi meliora et viciniora saluti tametsi ita loquimur
clem: Confidimus autem de vobis dilectissimi meliora, et viciniora saluti: tametsi ita loquimur.
tr: πεπεισμεθα δε περι υμων αγαπητοι τα κρειττονα και εχομενα σωτηριας ει και ουτως λαλουμεν
kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

vulg: non enim iniustus Deus ut obliviscatur operis vestri et dilectionis quam ostendistis in nomine ipsius qui ministrastis sanctis et ministratis
clem: Non enim injustus Deus, ut obliviscatur operis vestri, et dilectionis, quam ostendistis in nomine ipsius, qui ministrastis sanctis, et ministratis.
tr: ου γαρ αδικος ο θεος επιλαθεσθαι του εργου υμων και του κοπου της αγαπης ης ενεδειξασθε  ενδειξασθε  εις το ονομα αυτου διακονησαντες τοις αγιοις και διακονουντες
kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

vulg: cupimus autem unumquemque vestrum eandem ostentare sollicitudinem ad expletionem spei usque in finem
clem: Cupimus autem unumquemque vestrum eamdem ostentare sollicitudinem ad expletionem spei usque in finem:
tr: επιθυμουμεν δε εκαστον υμων την αυτην ενδεικνυσθαι σπουδην προς την πληροφοριαν της ελπιδος αχρι τελους
kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

vulg: ut non segnes efficiamini verum imitatores eorum qui fide et patientia hereditabunt promissiones
clem: ut non segnes efficiamini, verum imitatores eorum, qui fide, et patientia hreditabunt promissiones.
tr: ινα μη νωθροι γενησθε μιμηται δε των δια πιστεως και μακροθυμιας κληρονομουντων τας επαγγελιας
kjv: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

vulg: Abrahae namque promittens Deus quoniam neminem habuit per quem iuraret maiorem iuravit per semet ipsum
clem: Abrah namque promittens Deus, quoniam neminem habuit, per quem juraret, majorem, juravit per semetipsum,
tr: τω γαρ αβρααμ επαγγειλαμενος ο θεος επει κατ ουδενος ειχεν μειζονος ομοσαι ωμοσεν καθ εαυτου
kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

vulg: dicens nisi benedicens benedicam te et multiplicans multiplicabo te
clem: dicens: Nisi benedicens benedicam te, et multiplicans multiplicabo te.
tr: λεγων η μην ευλογων ευλογησω σε και πληθυνων πληθυνω σε
kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

vulg: et sic longanimiter ferens adeptus est repromissionem
clem: Et sic longanimiter ferens, adeptus est repromissionem.
tr: και ουτως μακροθυμησας επετυχεν της επαγγελιας
kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

vulg: homines enim per maiorem sui iurant et omnis controversiae eorum finis ad confirmationem est iuramentum
clem: Homines enim per majorem sui jurant: et omnis controversi eorum finis, ad confirmationem, est juramentum.
tr: ανθρωποι μεν γαρ κατα του μειζονος ομνυουσιν και πασης αυτοις αντιλογιας περας εις βεβαιωσιν ο ορκος
kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

vulg: in quo abundantius volens Deus ostendere pollicitationis heredibus inmobilitatem consilii sui interposuit iusiurandum
clem: In quo abundantius volens Deus ostendere pollicitationis hredibus, immobilitatem consilii sui, interposuit jusjurandum:
tr: εν ω περισσοτερον βουλομενος ο θεος επιδειξαι τοις κληρονομοις της επαγγελιας το αμεταθετον της βουλης αυτου εμεσιτευσεν ορκω
kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

vulg: ut per duas res inmobiles quibus inpossibile est mentiri Deum fortissimum solacium habeamus qui confugimus ad tenendam propositam spem
clem: ut per duas res immobiles, quibus impossibile est mentiri Deum, fortissimum solatium habeamus, qui confugimus ad tenendam propositam spem,
tr: ινα δια δυο πραγματων αμεταθετων εν οις αδυνατον ψευσασθαι θεον ισχυραν παρακλησιν εχωμεν οι καταφυγοντες κρατησαι της προκειμενης ελπιδος
kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

vulg: quam sicut anchoram habemus animae tutam ac firmam et incedentem usque in interiora velaminis
clem: quam sicut anchoram habemus anim tutam ac firmam, et incedentem usque ad interiora velaminis,
tr: ην ως αγκυραν εχομεν της ψυχης ασφαλη τε και βεβαιαν και εισερχομενην εις το εσωτερον του καταπετασματος
kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

vulg: ubi praecursor pro nobis introiit Iesus secundum ordinem Melchisedech pontifex factus in aeternum
clem: ubi prcursor pro nobis introivit Jesus, secundum ordinem Melchisedech pontifex factus in ternum.
tr: οπου προδρομος υπερ ημων εισηλθεν ιησους κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ αρχιερευς γενομενος εις τον αιωνα
kjv: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

vulg: hic enim Melchisedech rex Salem sacerdos Dei summi qui obviavit Abrahae regresso a caede regum et benedixit ei
clem: Hic enim Melchisedech, rex Salem, sacerdos Dei summi, qui obviavit Abrah regresso a cde regum, et benedixit ei:
tr: ουτος γαρ ο μελχισεδεκ βασιλευς σαλημ ιερευς του θεου του υψιστου ο συναντησας αβρααμ υποστρεφοντι απο της κοπης των βασιλεων και ευλογησας αυτον
kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

vulg: cui decimas omnium divisit Abraham primum quidem qui interpretatur rex iustitiae deinde autem et rex Salem quod est rex pacis
clem: cui et decimas omnium divisit Abraham: primum quidem qui interpretatur rex justiti: deinde autem et rex Salem, quod est, rex pacis,
tr: ω και δεκατην απο παντων εμερισεν αβρααμ πρωτον μεν ερμηνευομενος βασιλευς δικαιοσυνης επειτα δε και βασιλευς σαλημ ο εστιν βασιλευς ειρηνης
kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

vulg: sine patre sine matre sine genealogia neque initium dierum neque finem vitae habens adsimilatus autem Filio Dei manet sacerdos in perpetuum
clem: sine patre, sine matre, sine genealogia, neque initium dierum, neque finem vit habens, assimilatus autem Filio Dei, manet sacerdos in perpetuum.
tr: απατωρ αμητωρ αγενεαλογητος μητε αρχην ημερων μητε ζωης τελος εχων αφωμοιωμενος δε τω υιω του θεου μενει ιερευς εις το διηνεκες
kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

vulg: intuemini autem quantus sit hic cui et decimam dedit de praecipuis Abraham patriarcha
clem: Intuemini autem quantus sit hic, cui et decimas dedit de prcipuis Abraham patriarcha.
tr: θεωρειτε δε πηλικος ουτος ω και δεκατην αβρααμ εδωκεν εκ των ακροθινιων ο πατριαρχης
kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

vulg: et quidem de filiis Levi sacerdotium accipientes mandatum habent decimas sumere a populo secundum legem id est a fratribus suis quamquam et ipsi exierunt de lumbis Abrahae
clem: Et quidem de filiis Levi sacerdotium accipientes, mandatum habent decimas sumere a populo secundum legem, id est, a fratribus suis: quamquam et ipsi exierint de lumbis Abrah.
tr: και οι μεν εκ των υιων λευι την ιερατειαν λαμβανοντες εντολην εχουσιν αποδεκατουν τον λαον κατα τον νομον τουτ εστιν τους αδελφους αυτων καιπερ εξεληλυθοτας εκ της οσφυος αβρααμ
kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

vulg: cuius autem generatio non adnumeratur in eis decimas sumpsit Abraham et hunc qui habebat repromissiones benedixit
clem: Cujus autem generatio non annumeratur in eis, decimas sumpsit ab Abraham, et hunc, qui habebat repromissiones, benedixit.
tr: ο δε μη γενεαλογουμενος εξ αυτων δεδεκατωκεν τον αβρααμ και τον εχοντα τας επαγγελιας ευλογηκεν
kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

vulg: sine ulla autem contradictione quod minus est a meliore benedicitur
clem: Sine ulla autem contradictione, quod minus est, a meliore benedicitur.
tr: χωρις δε πασης αντιλογιας το ελαττον υπο του κρειττονος ευλογειται
kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

vulg: et hic quidem decimas morientes homines accipiunt ibi autem contestatus quia vivit
clem: Et hic quidem, decimas morientes homines accipiunt: ibi autem contestatur, quia vivit.
tr: και ωδε μεν δεκατας αποθνησκοντες ανθρωποι λαμβανουσιν εκει δε μαρτυρουμενος οτι ζη
kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

vulg: et ut ita dictum sit per Abraham et Levi qui decimas accipit decimatus est
clem: Et (ut ita dictum sit) per Abraham, et Levi, qui decimas accepit, decimatus est:
tr: και ως επος ειπειν δια αβρααμ και λευι ο δεκατας λαμβανων δεδεκατωται
kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

vulg: adhuc enim in lumbis patris erat quando obviavit ei Melchisedech
clem: adhuc enim in lumbis patris erat, quando obviavit ei Melchisedech.
tr: ετι γαρ εν τη οσφυι του πατρος ην οτε συνηντησεν αυτω ο μελχισεδεκ
kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

vulg: si ergo consummatio per sacerdotium leviticum erat populus enim sub ipso legem accepit quid adhuc necessarium secundum ordinem Melchisedech alium surgere sacerdotem et non secundum ordinem Aaron dici
clem: Si ergo consummatio per sacerdotium Leviticum erat (populus enim sub ipso legem accepit) quid adhuc necessarium fuit secundum ordinem Melchisedech, alium surgere sacerdotem, et non secundum ordinem Aaron dici?
tr: ει μεν ουν τελειωσις δια της λευιτικης ιερωσυνης ην ο λαος γαρ επ αυτη νενομοθετητο τις ετι χρεια κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ ετερον ανιστασθαι ιερεα και ου κατα την ταξιν ααρων λεγεσθαι
kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

vulg: translato enim sacerdotio necesse est ut et legis translatio fiat
clem: Translato enim sacerdotio, necesse erat ut et legis translatio fiat.
tr: μετατιθεμενης γαρ της ιερωσυνης εξ αναγκης και νομου μεταθεσις γινεται
kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

vulg: in quo enim haec dicuntur de alia tribu est de qua nullus altario praesto fuit
clem: In quo enim hc dicuntur, de alia tribu est, de qua nullus altari prsto fuit.
tr: εφ ον γαρ λεγεται ταυτα φυλης ετερας μετεσχηκεν αφ ης ουδεις προσεσχηκεν τω θυσιαστηριω
kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

vulg: manifestum enim quod ex Iuda ortus sit Dominus noster in qua tribu nihil de sacerdotibus Moses locutus est
clem: Manifestum est enim quod ex Juda ortus sit Dominus noster: in qua tribu nihil de sacerdotibus Moyses locutus est.
tr: προδηλον γαρ οτι εξ ιουδα ανατεταλκεν ο κυριος ημων εις ην φυλην ουδεν περι ιερωσυνης μωσης ελαλησεν
kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

vulg: et amplius adhuc manifestum est si secundum similitudinem Melchisedech exsurgit alius sacerdos
clem: Et amplius adhuc manifestum est: si secundum similitudinem Melchisedech exsurgat alius sacerdos,
tr: και περισσοτερον ετι καταδηλον εστιν ει κατα την ομοιοτητα μελχισεδεκ ανισταται ιερευς ετερος
kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

vulg: qui non secundum legem mandati carnalis factus est sed secundum virtutem vitae insolubilis
clem: qui non secundum legem mandati carnalis factus est, sed secundum virtutem vit insolubilis.
tr: ος ου κατα νομον εντολης σαρκικης γεγονεν αλλα κατα δυναμιν ζωης ακαταλυτου
kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

vulg: contestatur enim quoniam tu es sacerdos in aeternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech
clem: Contestatur enim: Quoniam tu es sacerdos in ternum, secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
tr: μαρτυρει γαρ οτι συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

vulg: reprobatio quidem fit praecedentis mandati propter infirmitatem eius et inutilitatem
clem: Reprobatio quidem fit prcedentis mandati, propter infirmitatem ejus, et inutilitatem:
tr: αθετησις μεν γαρ γινεται προαγουσης εντολης δια το αυτης ασθενες και ανωφελες
kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

vulg: nihil enim ad perfectum adduxit lex introductio vero melioris spei per quam proximamus ad Deum
clem: nihil enim ad perfectum adduxit lex: introductio vero melioris spei, per quam proximamus ad Deum.
tr: ουδεν γαρ ετελειωσεν ο νομος επεισαγωγη δε κρειττονος ελπιδος δι ης εγγιζομεν τω θεω
kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

vulg: et quantum est non sine iureiurando alii quidem sine iureiurando sacerdotes facti sunt
clem: Et quantum est non sine jurejurando (alii quidem sine jurejurando sacerdotes facti sunt,
tr: και καθ οσον ου χωρις ορκωμοσιας
kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

vulg: hic autem cum iureiurando per eum qui dixit ad illum iuravit Dominus et non paenitebit tu es sacerdos in aeternum
clem: hic autem cum jurejurando per eum, qui dixit ad illum: Juravit Dominus, et non pnitebit eum: tu es sacerdos in ternum):
tr: οι μεν γαρ χωρις ορκωμοσιας εισιν ιερεις γεγονοτες (7:21) ο δε μετα ορκωμοσιας δια του λεγοντος προς αυτον ωμοσεν κυριος και ου μεταμεληθησεται συ ιερευς εις τον αιωνα κατα την ταξιν μελχισεδεκ
kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

vulg: in tantum melioris testamenti sponsor factus est Iesus
clem: in tantum melioris testamenti sponsor factus est Jesus.
tr: κατα τοσουτον κρειττονος διαθηκης γεγονεν εγγυος ιησους
kjv: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

vulg: et alii quidem plures facti sunt sacerdotes idcirco quod morte prohiberentur permanere
clem: Et alii quidem plures facti sunt sacerdotes, idcirco quod morte prohiberentur permanere:
tr: και οι μεν πλειονες εισιν γεγονοτες ιερεις δια το θανατω κωλυεσθαι παραμενειν
kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

vulg: hic autem eo quod maneat in aeternum sempiternum habet sacerdotium
clem: hic autem eo quod maneat in ternum, sempiternum habet sacerdotium.
tr: ο δε δια το μενειν αυτον εις τον αιωνα απαραβατον εχει την ιερωσυνην
kjv: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

vulg: unde et salvare in perpetuo potest accedentes per semet ipsum ad Deum semper vivens ad interpellandum pro eis
clem: Unde et salvare in perpetuum potest accedentes per semetipsum ad Deum: semper vivens ad interpellandum pro nobis.
tr: οθεν και σωζειν εις το παντελες δυναται τους προσερχομενους δι αυτου τω θεω παντοτε ζων εις το εντυγχανειν υπερ αυτων
kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

vulg: talis enim decebat ut nobis esset pontifex sanctus innocens inpollutus segregatus a peccatoribus et excelsior caelis factus
clem: Talis enim decebat ut nobis esset pontifex, sanctus, innocens, impollutus, segregatus a peccatoribus, et excelsior clis factus:
tr: τοιουτος γαρ ημιν επρεπεν αρχιερευς οσιος ακακος αμιαντος κεχωρισμενος απο των αμαρτωλων και υψηλοτερος των ουρανων γενομενος
kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

vulg: qui non habet cotidie necessitatem quemadmodum sacerdotes prius pro suis delictis hostias offerre deinde pro populi hoc enim fecit semel se offerendo
clem: qui non habet necessitatem quotidie, quemadmodum sacerdotes, prius pro suis delictis hostias offerre, deinde pro populi: hoc enim fecit semel, seipsum offerendo.
tr: ος ουκ εχει καθ ημεραν αναγκην ωσπερ οι αρχιερεις προτερον υπερ των ιδιων αμαρτιων θυσιας αναφερειν επειτα των του λαου τουτο γαρ εποιησεν εφαπαξ εαυτον ανενεγκας
kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

vulg: lex enim homines constituit sacerdotes infirmitatem habentes sermo autem iurisiurandi qui post legem est Filium in aeternum perfectum
clem: Lex enim homines constituit sacerdotes infirmitatem habentes: sermo autem jurisjurandi, qui post legem est, Filium in ternum perfectum.
tr: ο νομος γαρ ανθρωπους καθιστησιν αρχιερεις εχοντας ασθενειαν ο λογος δε της ορκωμοσιας της μετα τον νομον υιον εις τον αιωνα τετελειωμενον
kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

vulg: capitulum autem super ea quae dicuntur talem habemus pontificem qui consedit in dextera sedis Magnitudinis in caelis
clem: Capitulum autem super ea qu dicuntur: Talem habemus pontificem, qui consedit in dextera sedis magnitudinis in clis,
tr: κεφαλαιον δε επι τοις λεγομενοις τοιουτον εχομεν αρχιερεα ος εκαθισεν εν δεξια του θρονου της μεγαλωσυνης εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

vulg: sanctorum minister et tabernaculi veri quod fixit Dominus et non homo
clem: sanctorum minister, et tabernaculi veri, quod fixit Dominus, et non homo.
tr: των αγιων λειτουργος και της σκηνης της αληθινης ην επηξεν ο κυριος και ουκ ανθρωπος
kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

vulg: omnis enim pontifex ad offerenda munera et hostias constituitur unde necesse est et hunc habere aliquid quod offerat
clem: Omnis enim pontifex ad offerendum munera, et hostias constituitur: unde necesse est et hunc habere aliquid, quod offerat.
tr: πας γαρ αρχιερευς εις το προσφερειν δωρα τε και θυσιας καθισταται οθεν αναγκαιον εχειν τι και τουτον ο προσενεγκη
kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

vulg: si ergo esset super terram nec esset sacerdos cum essent qui offerrent secundum legem munera
clem: Si ergo esset super terram, nec esset sacerdos: cum essent qui offerent secundum legem munera,
tr: ει μεν γαρ ην επι γης ουδ αν ην ιερευς οντων των ιερεων των προσφεροντων κατα τον νομον τα δωρα
kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

vulg: qui exemplari et umbrae deserviunt caelestium sicut responsum est Mosi cum consummaret tabernaculum vide inquit omnia facito secundum exemplar quod tibi ostensum est in monte
clem: qui exemplari, et umbr deserviunt clestium. Sicut responsum est Moysi, cum consummaret tabernaculum: Vide (inquit) omnia facito secundum exemplar, quod tibi ostensum est in monte.
tr: οιτινες υποδειγματι και σκια λατρευουσιν των επουρανιων καθως κεχρηματισται μωσης μελλων επιτελειν την σκηνην ορα γαρ φησιν ποιησης παντα κατα τον τυπον τον δειχθεντα σοι εν τω ορει
kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

vulg: nunc autem melius sortitus est ministerium quanto et melioris testamenti mediator est quod in melioribus repromissionibus sanctum est
clem: Nunc autem melius sortitus est ministerium, quanto et melioris testamenti mediator est, quod in melioribus repromissionibus sancitum est.
tr: νυνι δε διαφορωτερας τετευχεν λειτουργιας οσω και κρειττονος εστιν διαθηκης μεσιτης ητις επι κρειττοσιν επαγγελιαις νενομοθετηται
kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

vulg: nam si illud prius culpa vacasset non utique secundi locus inquireretur
clem: Nam si illud prius culpa vacasset, non utique secundi locus inquireretur.
tr: ει γαρ η πρωτη εκεινη ην αμεμπτος ουκ αν δευτερας εζητειτο τοπος
kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

vulg: vituperans enim eos dicit ecce dies veniunt dicit Dominus et consummabo super domum Israhel et super domum Iuda testamentum novum
clem: Vituperans enim eos dicit: Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus: et consummabo super domum Isral, et super domum Juda, testamentum novum,
tr: μεμφομενος γαρ αυτοις λεγει ιδου ημεραι ερχονται λεγει κυριος και συντελεσω επι τον οικον ισραηλ και επι τον οικον ιουδα διαθηκην καινην
kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

vulg: non secundum testamentum quod feci patribus eorum in die qua adprehendi manum illorum ut educerem illos de terra Aegypti quoniam ipsi non permanserunt in testamento meo et ego neglexi eos dicit Dominus
clem: non secundum testamentum quod feci patribus eorum in die qua apprehendi manum eorum ut educerem illos de terra gypti: quoniam ipsi non permanserunt in testamento meo: et ego neglexi eos, dicit Dominus.
tr: ου κατα την διαθηκην ην εποιησα τοις πατρασιν αυτων εν ημερα επιλαβομενου μου της χειρος αυτων εξαγαγειν αυτους εκ γης αιγυπτου οτι αυτοι ουκ ενεμειναν εν τη διαθηκη μου καγω ημελησα αυτων λεγει κυριος
kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

vulg: quia hoc testamentum quod disponam domui Israhel post dies illos dicit Dominus dando leges meas in mentem eorum et in corde eorum superscribam eas et ero eis in Deum et ipsi erunt mihi in populum
clem: Quia hoc est testamentum quod disponam domui Isral post dies illos, dicit Dominus: dando leges meas in mentem eorum, et in corde eorum superscribam eas: et ero eis in Deum, et ipsi erunt mihi in populum:
tr: οτι αυτη η διαθηκη ην διαθησομαι τω οικω ισραηλ μετα τας ημερας εκεινας λεγει κυριος διδους νομους μου εις την διανοιαν αυτων και επι καρδιας αυτων επιγραψω αυτους και εσομαι αυτοις εις θεον και αυτοι εσονται μοι εις λαον
kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

vulg: et non docebit unusquisque proximum suum et unusquisque fratrem suum dicens cognosce Dominum quoniam omnes scient me a minore usque ad maiorem eorum
clem: et non docebit unusquisque proximum suum, et unusquisque fratrem suum, dicens: Cognosce Dominum: quoniam omnes scient me a minore usque ad majorem eorum:
tr: και ου μη διδαξωσιν εκαστος τον πλησιον αυτου και εκαστος τον αδελφον αυτου λεγων γνωθι τον κυριον οτι παντες ειδησουσιν με απο μικρου αυτων εως μεγαλου αυτων
kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

vulg: quia propitius ero iniquitatibus eorum et peccatorum illorum iam non memorabor
clem: quia propitius ero iniquitatibus eorum, et peccatorum eorum jam non memorabor.
tr: οτι ιλεως εσομαι ταις αδικιαις αυτων και των αμαρτιων αυτων και των ανομιων αυτων ου μη μνησθω ετι
kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

vulg: dicendo autem novum veteravit prius quod autem antiquatur et senescit prope interitum est
clem: Dicendo autem novum: veteravit prius. Quod autem antiquatur, et senescit, prope interitum est.
tr: εν τω λεγειν καινην πεπαλαιωκεν την πρωτην το δε παλαιουμενον και γηρασκον εγγυς αφανισμου
kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

vulg: habuit quidem et prius iustificationes culturae et sanctum saeculare
clem: Habuit quidem et prius justificationes cultur, et Sanctum sculare.
tr: ειχεν μεν ουν και η πρωτη σκηνη   δικαιωματα λατρειας το τε αγιον κοσμικον
kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

vulg: tabernaculum enim factum est primum in quo inerant candelabra et mensa et propositio panum quae dicitur sancta
clem: Tabernaculum enim factum est primum, in quo erant candelabra, et mensa, et propositio panum, qu dicitur Sancta.
tr: σκηνη γαρ κατεσκευασθη η πρωτη εν η η τε λυχνια και η τραπεζα και η προθεσις των αρτων ητις λεγεται αγια
kjv: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

vulg: post velamentum autem secundum tabernaculum quod dicitur sancta sanctorum
clem: Post velamentum autem secundum, tabernaculum, quod dicitur Sancta sanctorum:
tr: μετα δε το δευτερον καταπετασμα σκηνη η λεγομενη αγια αγιων
kjv: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

vulg: aureum habens turibulum et arcam testamenti circumtectam ex omni parte auro in qua urna aurea habens manna et virga Aaron quae fronduerat et tabulae testamenti
clem: aureum habens thuribulum, et arcam testamenti circumtectam ex omni parte auro, in qua urna aurea habens manna, et virga Aaron, qu fronduerat, et tabul testamenti,
tr: χρυσουν εχουσα θυμιατηριον και την κιβωτον της διαθηκης περικεκαλυμμενην παντοθεν χρυσιω εν η σταμνος χρυση εχουσα το μαννα και η ραβδος ααρων η βλαστησασα και αι πλακες της διαθηκης
kjv: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

vulg: superque eam cherubin gloriae obumbrantia propitiatorium de quibus non est modo dicendum per singula
clem: superque eam erant cherubim glori obumbrantia propitiatorium: de quibus non est modo dicendum per singula.
tr: υπερανω δε αυτης χερουβιμ δοξης κατασκιαζοντα το ιλαστηριον περι ων ουκ εστιν νυν λεγειν κατα μερος
kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

vulg: his vero ita conpositis in priori quidem tabernaculo semper introibant sacerdotes sacrificiorum officia consummantes
clem: His vero ita compositis, in priori quidem tabernaculo semper introibant sacerdotes, sacrificiorum officia consummantes:
tr: τουτων δε ουτως κατεσκευασμενων εις μεν την πρωτην σκηνην διαπαντος  δια παντος  εισιασιν οι ιερεις τας λατρειας επιτελουντες
kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

vulg: in secundo autem semel in anno solus pontifex non sine sanguine quem offert pro sua et populi ignorantia
clem: in secundo autem semel in anno solus pontifex non sine sanguine, quem offert pro sua et populi ignorantia:
tr: εις δε την δευτεραν απαξ του ενιαυτου μονος ο αρχιερευς ου χωρις αιματος ο προσφερει υπερ εαυτου και των του λαου αγνοηματων
kjv: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

vulg: hoc significante Spiritu Sancto nondum propalatam esse sanctorum viam adhuc priore tabernaculo habente statum
clem: hoc significante Spiritu Sancto, nondum propalatam esse sanctorum viam, adhuc priore tabernaculo habente statum:
tr: τουτο δηλουντος του πνευματος του αγιου μηπω πεφανερωσθαι την των αγιων οδον ετι της πρωτης σκηνης εχουσης στασιν
kjv: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

vulg: quae parabola est temporis instantis iuxta quam munera et hostiae offeruntur quae non possunt iuxta conscientiam perfectum facere servientem
clem: qu parabola est temporis instantis: juxta quam munera, et hosti offeruntur, qu non possunt juxta conscientiam perfectum facere servientem, solummodo in cibis, et in potibus,
tr: ητις παραβολη εις τον καιρον τον ενεστηκοτα καθ ον δωρα τε και θυσιαι προσφερονται μη δυναμεναι κατα συνειδησιν τελειωσαι τον λατρευοντα
kjv: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

vulg: solummodo in cibis et in potibus et variis baptismis et iustitiis carnis usque ad tempus correctionis inpositis
clem: et variis baptismatibus, et justitiis carnis usque ad tempus correctionis impositis.
tr: μονον επι βρωμασιν και πομασιν και διαφοροις βαπτισμοις και δικαιωμασιν σαρκος μεχρι καιρου διορθωσεως επικειμενα
kjv: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

vulg: Christus autem adsistens pontifex futurorum bonorum per amplius et perfectius tabernaculum non manufactum id est non huius creationis
clem: Christus autem assistens pontifex futurorum bonorum, per amplius et perfectius tabernaculum, non manufactum, id est, non hujus creationis:
tr: χριστος δε παραγενομενος αρχιερευς των μελλοντων αγαθων δια της μειζονος και τελειοτερας σκηνης ου χειροποιητου τουτ εστιν ου ταυτης της κτισεως
kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

vulg: neque per sanguinem hircorum et vitulorum sed per proprium sanguinem introivit semel in sancta aeterna redemptione inventa
clem: neque per sanguinem hircorum aut vitulorum, sed per proprium sanguinem introivit semel in Sancta, terna redemptione inventa.
tr: ουδε δι αιματος τραγων και μοσχων δια δε του ιδιου αιματος εισηλθεν εφαπαξ εις τα αγια αιωνιαν λυτρωσιν ευραμενος
kjv: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

vulg: si enim sanguis hircorum et taurorum et cinis vitulae aspersus inquinatos sanctificat ad emundationem carnis
clem: Si enim sanguis hircorum et taurorum, et cinis vitul aspersus inquinatos sanctificat ad emundationem carnis:
tr: ει γαρ το αιμα ταυρων και τραγων και σποδος δαμαλεως ραντιζουσα τους κεκοινωμενους αγιαζει προς την της σαρκος καθαροτητα
kjv: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

vulg: quanto magis sanguis Christi qui per Spiritum Sanctum semet ipsum obtulit inmaculatum Deo emundabit conscientiam vestram ab operibus mortuis ad serviendum Deo viventi
clem: quanto magis sanguis Christi, qui per Spiritum Sanctum semetipsum obtulit immaculatum Deo, emundabit conscientiam nostram ab operibus mortuis, ad serviendum Deo viventi?
tr: ποσω μαλλον το αιμα του χριστου ος δια πνευματος αιωνιου εαυτον προσηνεγκεν αμωμον τω θεω καθαριει την συνειδησιν υμων απο νεκρων εργων εις το λατρευειν θεω ζωντι
kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

vulg: et ideo novi testamenti mediator est ut morte intercedente in redemptionem earum praevaricationum quae erant sub priore testamento repromissionem accipiant qui vocati sunt aeternae hereditatis
clem: Et ideo novi testamenti mediator est: ut morte intercedente, in redemptionem earum prvaricationum, qu erant sub priori testamento, repromissionem accipiant qui vocati sunt tern hreditatis.
tr: και δια τουτο διαθηκης καινης μεσιτης εστιν οπως θανατου γενομενου εις απολυτρωσιν των επι τη πρωτη διαθηκη παραβασεων την επαγγελιαν λαβωσιν οι κεκλημενοι της αιωνιου κληρονομιας
kjv: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

vulg: ubi enim testamentum mors necesse est intercedat testatoris
clem: Ubi enim testamentum est, mors necesse est intercedat testatoris.
tr: οπου γαρ διαθηκη θανατον αναγκη φερεσθαι του διαθεμενου
kjv: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

vulg: testamentum enim in mortuis confirmatum est alioquin nondum valet dum vivit qui testatus est
clem: Testamentum enim in mortuis confirmatum est: alioquin nondum valet, dum vivit qui testatus est.
tr: διαθηκη γαρ επι νεκροις βεβαια επει μηποτε ισχυει οτε ζη ο διαθεμενος
kjv: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

vulg: unde ne primum quidem sine sanguine dedicatum est
clem: Unde nec primum quidem sine sanguine dedicatum est.
tr: οθεν ουδ η πρωτη χωρις αιματος εγκεκαινισται
kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

vulg: lecto enim omni mandato legis a Mose universo populo accipiens sanguinem vitulorum et hircorum cum aqua et lana coccinea et hysopo ipsum quoque librum et omnem populum aspersit
clem: Lecto enim omni mandato legis a Moyse universo populo, accipiens sanguinem vitulorum et hircorum cum aqua, et lana coccinea, et hyssopo, ipsum quoque librum, et omnem populum aspersit,
tr: λαληθεισης γαρ πασης εντολης κατα νομον υπο μωυσεως παντι τω λαω λαβων το αιμα των μοσχων και τραγων μετα υδατος και εριου κοκκινου και υσσωπου αυτο τε το βιβλιον και παντα τον λαον ερραντισεν
kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

vulg: dicens hic sanguis testamenti quod mandavit ad vos Deus
clem: dicens: Hic sanguis testamenti, quod mandavit ad vos Deus.
tr: λεγων τουτο το αιμα της διαθηκης ης ενετειλατο προς υμας ο θεος
kjv: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

vulg: etiam tabernaculum et omnia vasa ministerii sanguine similiter aspersit
clem: Etiam tabernaculum et omnia vasa ministerii sanguine similiter aspersit.
tr: και την σκηνην δε και παντα τα σκευη της λειτουργιας τω αιματι ομοιως ερραντισεν
kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

vulg: et omnia paene in sanguine mundantur secundum legem et sine sanguinis fusione non fit remissio
clem: Et omnia pene in sanguine secundum legem mundantur: et sine sanguinis effusione non fit remissio.
tr: και σχεδον εν αιματι παντα καθαριζεται κατα τον νομον και χωρις αιματεκχυσιας ου γινεται αφεσις
kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

vulg: necesse est ergo exemplaria quidem caelestium his mundari ipsa autem caelestia melioribus hostiis quam istis
clem: Necesse est ergo exemplaria quidem clestium his mundari: ipsa autem clestia melioribus hostiis quam istis.
tr: αναγκη ουν τα μεν υποδειγματα των εν τοις ουρανοις τουτοις καθαριζεσθαι αυτα δε τα επουρανια κρειττοσιν θυσιαις παρα ταυτας
kjv: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

vulg: non enim in manufactis sanctis Iesus introiit exemplaria verorum sed in ipsum caelum ut appareat nunc vultui Dei pro nobis
clem: Non enim in manufacta Sancta Jesus introivit exemplaria verorum: sed in ipsum clum, ut appareat nunc vultui Dei pro nobis:
tr: ου γαρ εις χειροποιητα αγια εισηλθεν ο χριστος αντιτυπα των αληθινων αλλ εις αυτον τον ουρανον νυν εμφανισθηναι τω προσωπω του θεου υπερ ημων
kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

vulg: neque ut saepe offerat semet ipsum quemadmodum pontifex intrat in sancta per singulos annos in sanguine alieno
clem: neque ut spe offerat semetipsum, quemadmodum pontifex intrat in Sancta per singulos annos in sanguine alieno:
tr: ουδ ινα πολλακις προσφερη εαυτον ωσπερ ο αρχιερευς εισερχεται εις τα αγια κατ ενιαυτον εν αιματι αλλοτριω
kjv: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

vulg: alioquin oportebat eum frequenter pati ab origine mundi nunc autem semel in consummatione saeculorum ad destitutionem peccati per hostiam suam apparuit
clem: alioquin oportebat eum frequenter pati ab origine mundi: nunc autem semel in consummatione sculorum, ad destitutionem peccati, per hostiam suam apparuit.
tr: επει εδει αυτον πολλακις παθειν απο καταβολης κοσμου νυν δε απαξ επι συντελεια των αιωνων εις αθετησιν αμαρτιας δια της θυσιας αυτου πεφανερωται
kjv: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

vulg: et quemadmodum statutum est hominibus semel mori post hoc autem iudicium
clem: Et quemadmodum statutum est hominibus semel mori, post hoc autem judicium:
tr: και καθ οσον αποκειται τοις ανθρωποις απαξ αποθανειν μετα δε τουτο κρισις
kjv: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

vulg: sic et Christus semel oblatus ad multorum exhaurienda peccata secundo sine peccato apparebit expectantibus se in salutem
clem: sic et Christus semel oblatus est ad multorum exhaurienda peccata: secundo sine peccato apparebit exspectantibus se, in salutem.
tr: ουτως ο χριστος απαξ προσενεχθεις εις το πολλων ανενεγκειν αμαρτιας εκ δευτερου χωρις αμαρτιας οφθησεται τοις αυτον απεκδεχομενοις εις σωτηριαν
