kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

vulg: umbram enim habens lex bonorum futurorum non ipsam imaginem rerum per singulos annos hisdem ipsis hostiis quas offerunt indesinenter numquam potest accedentes perfectos facere
clem: Umbram enim habens lex futurorum bonorum, non ipsam imaginem rerum: per singulos annos, eisdem ipsis hostiis quas offerunt indesinenter, numquam potest accedentes perfectos facere:
tr: σκιαν γαρ εχων ο νομος των μελλοντων αγαθων ουκ αυτην την εικονα των πραγματων κατ ενιαυτον ταις αυταις θυσιαις ας προσφερουσιν εις το διηνεκες ουδεποτε δυναται τους προσερχομενους τελειωσαι
kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

vulg: alioquin non cessassent offerri ideo quod nullam haberent ultra conscientiam peccati cultores semel mundati
clem: alioquin cessassent offerri: ideo quod nullam haberent ultra conscientiam peccati, cultores semel mundati:
tr: επει ουκ αν επαυσαντο προσφερομεναι δια το μηδεμιαν εχειν ετι συνειδησιν αμαρτιων τους λατρευοντας απαξ κεκαθαρμενους
kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

vulg: sed in ipsis commemoratio peccatorum per singulos annos fit
clem: sed in ipsis commemoratio peccatorum per singulos annos fit.
tr: αλλ εν αυταις αναμνησις αμαρτιων κατ ενιαυτον
kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

vulg: inpossibile enim est sanguine taurorum et hircorum auferri peccata
clem: Impossibile enim est sanguine taurorum et hircorum auferri peccata.
tr: αδυνατον γαρ αιμα ταυρων και τραγων αφαιρειν αμαρτιας
kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

vulg: ideo ingrediens mundum dicit hostiam et oblationem noluisti corpus autem aptasti mihi
clem: Ideo ingrediens mundum dicit: Hostiam et oblationem noluisti: corpus autem aptasti mihi:
tr: διο εισερχομενος εις τον κοσμον λεγει θυσιαν και προσφοραν ουκ ηθελησας σωμα δε κατηρτισω μοι
kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

vulg: holocaustomata et pro peccato non tibi placuit
clem: holocautomata pro peccato non tibi placuerunt.
tr: ολοκαυτωματα και περι αμαρτιας ουκ ευδοκησας
kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

vulg: tunc dixi ecce venio in capitulo libri scriptum est de me ut faciam Deus voluntatem tuam
clem: Tunc dixi: Ecce venio: in capite libri scriptum est de me: Ut faciam, Deus, voluntatem tuam.
tr: τοτε ειπον ιδου ηκω εν κεφαλιδι βιβλιου γεγραπται περι εμου του ποιησαι ο θεος το θελημα σου
kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

vulg: superius dicens quia hostias et oblationes et holocaustomata et pro peccato noluisti nec placita sunt tibi quae secundum legem offeruntur
clem: Superius dicens: Quia hostias, et oblationes, et holocautomata pro peccato noluisti, nec placita sunt tibi, qu secundum legem offeruntur,
tr: ανωτερον λεγων οτι θυσιαν και προσφοραν και ολοκαυτωματα και περι αμαρτιας ουκ ηθελησας ουδε ευδοκησας αιτινες κατα τον νομον προσφερονται
kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

vulg: tunc dixit ecce venio ut faciam Deus voluntatem tuam aufert primum ut sequens statuat
clem: tunc dixi: Ecce venio, ut faciam, Deus, voluntatem tuam: aufert primum, ut sequens statuat.
tr: τοτε ειρηκεν ιδου ηκω του ποιησαι ο θεος το θελημα σου αναιρει το πρωτον ινα το δευτερον στηση
kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

vulg: in qua voluntate sanctificati sumus per oblationem corporis Christi Iesu in semel
clem: In qua voluntate sanctificati sumus per oblationem corporis Jesu Christi semel.
tr: εν ω θεληματι ηγιασμενοι εσμεν οι   δια της προσφορας του σωματος του ιησου χριστου εφαπαξ
kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

vulg: et omnis quidem sacerdos praesto est cotidie ministrans et easdem saepe offerens hostias quae numquam possunt auferre peccata
clem: Et omnis quidem sacerdos prsto est quotidie ministrans, et easdem spe offerens hostias, qu numquam possunt auferre peccata:
tr: και πας μεν ιερευς εστηκεν καθ ημεραν λειτουργων και τας αυτας πολλακις προσφερων θυσιας αιτινες ουδεποτε δυνανται περιελειν αμαρτιας
kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

vulg: hic autem unam pro peccatis offerens hostiam in sempiternum sedit in dextera Dei
clem: hic autem unam pro peccatis offerens hostiam, in sempiternum sedet in dextera Dei,
tr: αυτος δε μιαν υπερ αμαρτιων προσενεγκας θυσιαν εις το διηνεκες εκαθισεν εν δεξια του θεου
kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

vulg: de cetero expectans donec ponantur inimici eius scabillum pedum eius
clem: de cetero exspectans donec ponantur inimici ejus scabellum pedum ejus.
tr: το λοιπον εκδεχομενος εως τεθωσιν οι εχθροι αυτου υποποδιον των ποδων αυτου
kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

vulg: una enim oblatione consummavit in sempiternum sanctificatos
clem: Una enim oblatione, consummavit in sempiternum sanctificatos.
tr: μια γαρ προσφορα τετελειωκεν εις το διηνεκες τους αγιαζομενους
kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

vulg: contestatur autem nos et Spiritus Sanctus postquam enim dixit
clem: Contestatur autem nos et Spiritus Sanctus. Postquam enim dixit:
tr: μαρτυρει δε ημιν και το πνευμα το αγιον μετα γαρ το προειρηκεναι
kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

vulg: hoc autem testamentum quod testabor ad illos post dies illos dicit Dominus dando leges meas in cordibus eorum et in mente eorum superscribam eas
clem: Hoc autem testamentum, quod testabor ad illos post dies illos, dicit Dominus, dando leges meas in cordibus eorum, et in mentibus eorum superscribam eas:
tr: αυτη η διαθηκη ην διαθησομαι προς αυτους μετα τας ημερας εκεινας λεγει κυριος διδους νομους μου επι καρδιας αυτων και επι των διανοιων αυτων επιγραψω αυτους
kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

vulg: et peccatorum et iniquitatium eorum iam non recordabor amplius
clem: et peccatorum, et iniquitatum eorum jam non recordabor amplius.
tr: και των αμαρτιων αυτων και των ανομιων αυτων ου μη μνησθω ετι
kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

vulg: ubi autem horum remissio iam non oblatio pro peccato
clem: Ubi autem horum remissio: jam non est oblatio pro peccato.
tr: οπου δε αφεσις τουτων ουκετι προσφορα περι αμαρτιας
kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

vulg: habentes itaque fratres fiduciam in introitu sanctorum in sanguine Christi
clem: Habentes itaque, fratres, fiduciam in introitu sanctorum in sanguine Christi,
tr: εχοντες ουν αδελφοι παρρησιαν εις την εισοδον των αγιων εν τω αιματι ιησου
kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

vulg: quam initiavit nobis viam novam et viventem per velamen id est carnem suam
clem: quam initiavit nobis viam novam, et viventem per velamen, id est, carnem suam,
tr: ην ενεκαινισεν ημιν οδον προσφατον και ζωσαν δια του καταπετασματος τουτ εστιν της σαρκος αυτου
kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

vulg: et sacerdotem magnum super domum Dei
clem: et sacerdotem magnum super domum Dei:
tr: και ιερεα μεγαν επι τον οικον του θεου
kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;

vulg: accedamus cum vero corde in plenitudine fidei aspersi corda a conscientia mala et abluti corpus aqua munda
clem: accedamus cum vero corde in plenitudine fidei, aspersi corda a conscientia mala, et abluti corpus aqua munda,
tr: προσερχωμεθα μετα αληθινης καρδιας εν πληροφορια πιστεως ερραντισμενοι τας καρδιας απο συνειδησεως πονηρας και λελουμενοι το σωμα υδατι καθαρω
kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

vulg: teneamus spei nostrae confessionem indeclinabilem fidelis enim est qui repromisit
clem: teneamus spei nostr confessionem indeclinabilem (fidelis enim est qui repromisit),
tr: κατεχωμεν την ομολογιαν της ελπιδος ακλινη πιστος γαρ ο επαγγειλαμενος
kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

vulg: et consideremus invicem in provocationem caritatis et bonorum operum
clem: et consideremus invicem in provocationem caritatis, et bonorum operum:
tr: και κατανοωμεν αλληλους εις παροξυσμον αγαπης και καλων εργων
kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

vulg: non deserentes collectionem nostram sicut est consuetudinis quibusdam sed consolantes et tanto magis quanto videritis adpropinquantem diem
clem: non deserentes collectionem nostram, sicut consuetudinis est quibusdam, sed consolantes, et tanto magis quanto videritis appropinquantem diem.
tr: μη εγκαταλειποντες την επισυναγωγην εαυτων καθως εθος τισιν αλλα παρακαλουντες και τοσουτω μαλλον οσω βλεπετε εγγιζουσαν την ημεραν
kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

vulg: voluntarie enim peccantibus nobis post acceptam notitiam veritatis iam non relinquitur pro peccatis hostia
clem: Voluntarie enim peccantibus nobis post acceptam notitiam veritatis, jam non relinquitur pro peccatis hostia,
tr: εκουσιως γαρ αμαρτανοντων ημων μετα το λαβειν την επιγνωσιν της αληθειας ουκετι περι αμαρτιων απολειπεται θυσια
kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

vulg: terribilis autem quaedam expectatio iudicii et ignis aemulatio quae consumptura est adversarios
clem: terribilis autem qudam exspectatio judicii, et ignis mulatio, qu consumptura est adversarios.
tr: φοβερα δε τις εκδοχη κρισεως και πυρος ζηλος εσθιειν μελλοντος τους υπεναντιους
kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

vulg: irritam quis faciens legem Mosi sine ulla miseratione duobus vel tribus testibus moritur
clem: Irritam quis faciens legem Moysi, sine ulla miseratione duobus vel tribus testibus moritur:
tr: αθετησας τις νομον μωσεως χωρις οικτιρμων επι δυσιν η τρισιν μαρτυσιν αποθνησκει
kjv: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

vulg: quanto magis putatis deteriora mereri supplicia qui Filium Dei conculcaverit et sanguinem testamenti pollutum duxerit in quo sanctificatus est et Spiritui gratiae contumeliam fecerit
clem: quanto magis putatis deteriora mereri supplicia qui Filium Dei conculcaverit, et sanguinem testamenti pollutum duxerit, in quo sanctificatus est, et spiritui grati contumeliam fecerit?
tr: ποσω δοκειτε χειρονος αξιωθησεται τιμωριας ο τον υιον του θεου καταπατησας και το αιμα της διαθηκης κοινον ηγησαμενος εν ω ηγιασθη και το πνευμα της χαριτος ενυβρισας
kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

vulg: scimus enim qui dixit mihi vindictam ego reddam et iterum quia iudicabit Dominus populum suum
clem: Scimus enim qui dixit: Mihi vindicta, et ego retribuam. Et iterum: Quia judicabit Dominus populum suum.
tr: οιδαμεν γαρ τον ειποντα εμοι εκδικησις εγω ανταποδωσω λεγει κυριος και παλιν κυριος κρινει τον λαον αυτου
kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

vulg: horrendum est incidere in manus Dei viventis
clem: Horrendum est incidere in manus Dei viventis.
tr: φοβερον το εμπεσειν εις χειρας θεου ζωντος
kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

vulg: rememoramini autem pristinos dies in quibus inluminati magnum certamen sustinuistis passionum
clem: Rememoramini autem pristinos dies, in quibus illuminati, magnum certamen sustinuistis passionum:
tr: αναμιμνησκεσθε δε τας προτερον ημερας εν αις φωτισθεντες πολλην αθλησιν υπεμεινατε παθηματων
kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

vulg: et in altero quidem obprobriis et tribulationibus spectaculum facti in altero autem socii taliter conversantium effecti
clem: et in altero quidem opprobriis et tribulationibus spectaculum facti: in altero autem socii taliter conversantium effecti.
tr: τουτο μεν ονειδισμοις τε και θλιψεσιν θεατριζομενοι τουτο δε κοινωνοι των ουτως αναστρεφομενων γενηθεντες
kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

vulg: nam et vinctis conpassi estis et rapinam bonorum vestrorum cum gaudio suscepistis cognoscentes vos habere meliorem et manentem substantiam
clem: Nam et vinctis compassi estis, et rapinam bonorum vestrorum cum gaudio suscepistis, cognoscentes vos habere meliorem et manentem substantiam.
tr: και γαρ τοις δεσμοις μου συνεπαθησατε και την αρπαγην των υπαρχοντων υμων μετα χαρας προσεδεξασθε γινωσκοντες εχειν εν εαυτοις κρειττονα υπαρξιν εν ουρανοις και μενουσαν
kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

vulg: nolite itaque amittere confidentiam vestram quae magnam habet remunerationem
clem: Nolite itaque amittere confidentiam vestram, qu magnam habet remunerationem.
tr: μη αποβαλητε ουν την παρρησιαν υμων ητις εχει μισθαποδοσιαν μεγαλην
kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

vulg: patientia enim vobis necessaria est ut voluntatem Dei facientes reportetis promissionem
clem: Patientia enim vobis necessaria est: ut voluntatem Dei facientes, reportetis promissionem.
tr: υπομονης γαρ εχετε χρειαν ινα το θελημα του θεου ποιησαντες κομισησθε την επαγγελιαν
kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

vulg: adhuc enim modicum quantulum qui venturus est veniet et non tardabit
clem: Adhuc enim modicum aliquantulum, qui venturus est, veniet, et non tardabit.
tr: ετι γαρ μικρον οσον οσον ο ερχομενος ηξει και ου χρονιει
kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

vulg: iustus autem meus ex fide vivit quod si subtraxerit se non placebit animae meae
clem: Justus autem meus ex fide vivit: quod si subtraxerit se, non placebit anim me.
tr: ο δε δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται και εαν υποστειληται ουκ ευδοκει η ψυχη μου εν αυτω
kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

vulg: nos autem non sumus subtractionis in perditionem sed fidei in adquisitionem animae
clem: Nos autem non sumus subtractionis filii in perditionem, sed fidei in acquisitionem anim.
tr: ημεις δε ουκ εσμεν υποστολης εις απωλειαν αλλα πιστεως εις περιποιησιν ψυχης
kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

vulg: est autem fides sperandorum substantia rerum argumentum non parentum
clem: Est autem fides sperandarum substantia rerum, argumentum non apparentium.
tr: εστιν δε πιστις ελπιζομενων υποστασις πραγματων ελεγχος ου βλεπομενων
kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

vulg: in hac enim testimonium consecuti sunt senes
clem: In hac enim testimonium consecuti sunt senes.
tr: εν ταυτη γαρ εμαρτυρηθησαν οι πρεσβυτεροι
kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

vulg: fide intellegimus aptata esse saecula verbo Dei ut ex invisibilibus visibilia fierent
clem: Fide intelligimus aptata esse scula verbo Dei: ut ex invisibilibus visibilia fierent.
tr: πιστει νοουμεν κατηρτισθαι τους αιωνας ρηματι θεου εις το μη εκ φαινομενων τα βλεπομενα γεγονεναι
kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

vulg: fide plurimam hostiam Abel quam Cain obtulit Deo per quam testimonium consecutus est esse iustus testimonium perhibente muneribus eius Deo et per illam defunctus adhuc loquitur
clem: Fide plurimam hostiam Abel, quam Cain, obtulit Deo, per quam testimonium consecutus est esse justus, testimonium perhibente muneribus ejus Deo, et per illam defunctus adhuc loquitur.
tr: πιστει πλειονα θυσιαν αβελ παρα καιν προσηνεγκεν τω θεω δι ης εμαρτυρηθη ειναι δικαιος μαρτυρουντος επι τοις δωροις αυτου του θεου και δι αυτης αποθανων ετι λαλειται  λαλει
kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

vulg: fide Enoch translatus est ne videret mortem et non inveniebatur quia transtulit illum Deus ante translationem enim testimonium habebat placuisse Deo
clem: Fide Henoch translatus est ne videret mortem, et non inveniebatur, quia transtulit illum Deus: ante translationem enim testimonium habuit placuisse Deo.
tr: πιστει ενωχ μετετεθη του μη ιδειν θανατον και ουχ ευρισκετο διοτι μετεθηκεν αυτον ο θεος προ γαρ της μεταθεσεως αυτου μεμαρτυρηται ευηρεστηκεναι τω θεω
kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

vulg: sine fide autem inpossibile placere credere enim oportet accedentem ad Deum quia est et inquirentibus se remunerator fit
clem: Sine fide autem impossibile est placere Deo. Credere enim oportet accedentem ad Deum quia est, et inquirentibus se remunerator sit.
tr: χωρις δε πιστεως αδυνατον ευαρεστησαι πιστευσαι γαρ δει τον προσερχομενον τω θεω οτι εστιν και τοις εκζητουσιν αυτον μισθαποδοτης γινεται
kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

vulg: fide Noe responso accepto de his quae adhuc non videbantur metuens aptavit arcam in salutem domus suae per quam damnavit mundum et iustitiae quae per fidem est heres est institutus
clem: Fide No responso accepto de iis qu adhuc non videbantur, metuens aptavit arcam in salutem domus su, per quam damnavit mundum: et justiti, qu per fidem est, hres est institutus.
tr: πιστει χρηματισθεις νωε περι των μηδεπω βλεπομενων ευλαβηθεις κατεσκευασεν κιβωτον εις σωτηριαν του οικου αυτου δι ης κατεκρινεν τον κοσμον και της κατα πιστιν δικαιοσυνης εγενετο κληρονομος
kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

vulg: fide qui vocatur Abraham oboedivit in locum exire quem accepturus erat in hereditatem et exiit nesciens quo iret
clem: Fide qui vocatur Abraham obedivit in locum exire, quem accepturus erat in hreditatem: et exiit, nesciens quo iret.
tr: πιστει καλουμενος αβρααμ υπηκουσεν εξελθειν εις τον τοπον ον ημελλεν λαμβανειν εις κληρονομιαν και εξηλθεν μη επισταμενος που ερχεται
kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

vulg: fide moratus est in terra repromissionis tamquam in aliena in casulis habitando cum Isaac et Iacob coheredibus repromissionis eiusdem
clem: Fide demoratus est in terra repromissionis, tamquam in aliena, in casulis habitando cum Isaac et Jacob cohredibus repromissionis ejusdem.
tr: πιστει παρωκησεν εις την γην της επαγγελιας ως αλλοτριαν εν σκηναις κατοικησας μετα ισαακ και ιακωβ των συγκληρονομων της επαγγελιας της αυτης
kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

vulg: expectabat enim fundamenta habentem civitatem cuius artifex et conditor Deus
clem: Exspectabat enim fundamenta habentem civitatem: cujus artifex et conditor Deus.
tr: εξεδεχετο γαρ την τους θεμελιους εχουσαν πολιν ης τεχνιτης και δημιουργος ο θεος
kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

vulg: fide et ipsa Sarra sterilis virtutem in conceptionem seminis accepit etiam praeter tempus aetatis quoniam fidelem credidit esse qui promiserat
clem: Fide et ipsa Sara sterilis virtutem in conceptionem seminis accepit, etiam prter tempus tatis: quoniam fidelem credidit esse eum qui repromiserat.
tr: πιστει και αυτη σαρρα δυναμιν εις καταβολην σπερματος ελαβεν και παρα καιρον ηλικιας ετεκεν επει πιστον ηγησατο τον επαγγειλαμενον
kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

vulg: propter quod et ab uno orti sunt et haec emortuo tamquam sidera caeli in multitudinem et sicut harena quae est ad oram maris innumerabilis
clem: Propter quod et ab uno orti sunt (et hoc emortuo) tamquam sidera cli in multitudinem, et sicut arena, qu est ad oram maris, innumerabilis.
tr: διο και αφ ενος εγεννηθησαν και ταυτα νενεκρωμενου καθως τα αστρα του ουρανου τω πληθει και ωσει αμμος η παρα το χειλος της θαλασσης η αναριθμητος
kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

vulg: iuxta fidem defuncti sunt omnes isti non acceptis repromissionibus sed a longe eas aspicientes et salutantes et confitentes quia peregrini et hospites sunt supra terram
clem: Juxta fidem defuncti sunt omnes isti, non acceptis repromissionibus, sed a longe eas aspicientes, et salutantes, et confitentes quia peregrini et hospites sunt super terram.
tr: κατα πιστιν απεθανον ουτοι παντες μη λαβοντες τας επαγγελιας αλλα πορρωθεν αυτας ιδοντες και πεισθεντες και ασπασαμενοι και ομολογησαντες οτι ξενοι και παρεπιδημοι εισιν επι της γης
kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

vulg: qui enim haec dicunt significant se patriam inquirere
clem: Qui enim hc dicunt, significant se patriam inquirere.
tr: οι γαρ τοιαυτα λεγοντες εμφανιζουσιν οτι πατριδα επιζητουσιν
kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

vulg: et si quidem illius meminissent de qua exierunt habebant utique tempus revertendi
clem: Et si quidem ipsius meminissent de qua exierunt, habebant utique tempus revertendi:
tr: και ει μεν εκεινης εμνημονευον αφ ης εξηλθον ειχον αν καιρον ανακαμψαι
kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

vulg: nunc autem meliorem appetunt id est caelestem ideo non confunditur Deus vocari Deus eorum paravit enim illis civitatem
clem: nunc autem meliorem appetunt, id est, clestem. Ideo non confunditur Deus vocari Deus eorum: paravit enim illis civitatem.
tr: νυνι δε κρειττονος ορεγονται τουτ εστιν επουρανιου διο ουκ επαισχυνεται αυτους ο θεος θεος επικαλεισθαι αυτων ητοιμασεν γαρ αυτοις πολιν
kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

vulg: fide obtulit Abraham Isaac cum temptaretur et unigenitum offerebat qui susceperat repromissiones
clem: Fide obtulit Abraham Isaac, cum tentaretur, et unigenitum offerebat, qui susceperat repromissiones:
tr: πιστει προσενηνοχεν αβρααμ τον ισαακ πειραζομενος και τον μονογενη προσεφερεν ο τας επαγγελιας αναδεξαμενος
kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

vulg: ad quem dictum est quia in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen
clem: ad quem dictum est: Quia in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen:
tr: προς ον ελαληθη οτι εν ισαακ κληθησεται σοι σπερμα
kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

vulg: arbitrans quia et a mortuis suscitare potens est Deus unde eum et in parabola accepit
clem: arbitrans quia et a mortuis suscitare potens est Deus: unde eum et in parabolam accepit.
tr: λογισαμενος οτι και εκ νεκρων εγειρειν δυνατος ο θεος οθεν αυτον και εν παραβολη εκομισατο
kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

vulg: fide et de futuris benedixit Isaac Iacob et Esau
clem: Fide et de futuris benedixit Isaac Jacob et Esau.
tr: πιστει περι μελλοντων ευλογησεν ισαακ τον ιακωβ και τον ησαυ
kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

vulg: fide Iacob moriens singulis filiorum Ioseph benedixit et adoravit fastigium virgae eius
clem: Fide Jacob, moriens, singulos filiorum Joseph benedixit: et adoravit fastigium virg ejus.
tr: πιστει ιακωβ αποθνησκων εκαστον των υιων ιωσηφ ευλογησεν και προσεκυνησεν επι το ακρον της ραβδου αυτου
kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

vulg: fide Ioseph moriens de profectione filiorum Israhel memoratus est et de ossibus suis mandavit
clem: Fide Joseph, moriens, de profectione filiorum Isral memoratus est, et de ossibus suis mandavit.
tr: πιστει ιωσηφ τελευτων περι της εξοδου των υιων ισραηλ εμνημονευσεν και περι των οστεων αυτου ενετειλατο
kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

vulg: fide Moses natus occultatus est mensibus tribus a parentibus suis eo quod vidissent elegantem infantem et non timuerunt regis edictum
clem: Fide Moyses, natus, occultatus est mensibus tribus a parentibus suis, eo quod vidissent elegantem infantem, et non timuerunt regis edictum.
tr: πιστει μωσης γεννηθεις εκρυβη τριμηνον υπο των πατερων αυτου διοτι ειδον αστειον το παιδιον και ουκ εφοβηθησαν το διαταγμα του βασιλεως
kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

vulg: fide Moses grandis factus negavit se esse filium filiae Pharaonis
clem: Fide Moyses grandis factus negavit se esse filium fili Pharaonis,
tr: πιστει μωσης μεγας γενομενος ηρνησατο λεγεσθαι υιος θυγατρος φαραω
kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

vulg: magis eligens adfligi cum populo Dei quam temporalis peccati habere iucunditatem
clem: magis eligens affligi cum populo Dei, quam temporalis peccati habere jucunditatem,
tr: μαλλον ελομενος συγκακουχεισθαι τω λαω του θεου η προσκαιρον εχειν αμαρτιας απολαυσιν
kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

vulg: maiores divitias aestimans thesauro Aegyptiorum inproperium Christi aspiciebat enim in remunerationem
clem: majores divitias stimans thesauro gyptiorum, improperium Christi: aspiciebat enim in remunerationem.
tr: μειζονα πλουτον ηγησαμενος των εν αιγυπτω θησαυρων τον ονειδισμον του χριστου απεβλεπεν γαρ εις την μισθαποδοσιαν
kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

vulg: fide reliquit Aegyptum non veritus animositatem regis invisibilem enim tamquam videns sustinuit
clem: Fide reliquit gyptum, non veritus animositatem regis: invisibilem enim tamquam videns sustinuit.
tr: πιστει κατελιπεν αιγυπτον μη φοβηθεις τον θυμον του βασιλεως τον γαρ αορατον ως ορων εκαρτερησεν
kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

vulg: fide celebravit pascha et sanguinis effusionem ne qui vastabat primitiva tangeret eos
clem: Fide celebravit Pascha, et sanguinis effusionem: ne qui vastabat primitiva, tangeret eos.
tr: πιστει πεποιηκεν το πασχα και την προσχυσιν του αιματος ινα μη ο ολοθρευων τα πρωτοτοκα θιγη αυτων
kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

vulg: fide transierunt mare Rubrum tamquam per aridam terram quod experti Aegyptii devorati sunt
clem: Fide transierunt mare Rubrum tamquam per aridam terram: quod experti gyptii, devorati sunt.
tr: πιστει διεβησαν την ερυθραν θαλασσαν ως δια ξηρας ης πειραν λαβοντες οι αιγυπτιοι κατεποθησαν
kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

vulg: fide muri Hiericho ruerunt circuiti dierum septem
clem: Fide muri Jericho corruerunt, circuitu dierum septem.
tr: πιστει τα τειχη ιεριχω επεσεν κυκλωθεντα επι επτα ημερας
kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

vulg: fide Raab meretrix non periit cum incredulis excipiens exploratores cum pace
clem: Fide Rahab meretrix non periit cum incredulis, excipiens exploratores cum pace.
tr: πιστει ρααβ η πορνη ου συναπωλετο τοις απειθησασιν δεξαμενη τους κατασκοπους μετ ειρηνης
kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

vulg: et quid adhuc dicam deficiet enim me tempus enarrantem de Gedeon Barac Samson Iepthae David et Samuhel et prophetis
clem: Et quid adhuc dicam? deficiet enim me tempus enarrantem de Gedeon, Barac, Samson, Jephte, David, Samuel, et prophetis:
tr: και τι ετι λεγω επιλειψει γαρ με διηγουμενον ο χρονος περι γεδεων βαρακ τε και σαμψων και ιεφθαε δαβιδ τε και σαμουηλ και των προφητων
kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

vulg: qui per fidem devicerunt regna operati sunt iustitiam adepti sunt repromissiones obturaverunt ora leonum
clem: qui per fidem vicerunt regna, operati sunt justitiam, adepti sunt repromissiones, obturaverunt ora leonum,
tr: οι δια πιστεως κατηγωνισαντο βασιλειας ειργασαντο δικαιοσυνην επετυχον επαγγελιων εφραξαν στοματα λεοντων
kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.

vulg: extinxerunt impetum ignis effugerunt aciem gladii convaluerunt de infirmitate fortes facti sunt in bello castra verterunt exterorum
clem: extinxerunt impetum ignis, effugerunt aciem gladii, convaluerunt de infirmitate, fortes facti sunt in bello, castra verterunt exterorum:
tr: εσβεσαν δυναμιν πυρος εφυγον στοματα μαχαιρας ενεδυναμωθησαν απο ασθενειας εγενηθησαν ισχυροι εν πολεμω παρεμβολας εκλιναν αλλοτριων
kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

vulg: acceperunt mulieres de resurrectione mortuos suos alii autem distenti sunt non suscipientes redemptionem ut meliorem invenirent resurrectionem
clem: acceperunt mulieres de resurrectione mortuos suos: alii autem distenti sunt non suscipientes redemptionem ut meliorem invenirent resurrectionem.
tr: ελαβον γυναικες εξ αναστασεως τους νεκρους αυτων αλλοι δε ετυμπανισθησαν ου προσδεξαμενοι την απολυτρωσιν ινα κρειττονος αναστασεως τυχωσιν
kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

vulg: alii vero ludibria et verbera experti insuper et vincula et carceres
clem: Alii vero ludibria, et verbera experti, insuper et vincula, et carceres:
tr: ετεροι δε εμπαιγμων και μαστιγων πειραν ελαβον ετι δε δεσμων και φυλακης
kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

vulg: lapidati sunt secti sunt temptati sunt in occisione gladii mortui sunt circumierunt in melotis in pellibus caprinis egentes angustiati adflicti
clem: lapidati sunt, secti sunt, tentati sunt, in occisione gladii mortui sunt, circuierunt in melotis, in pellibus caprinis, egentes, angustiati, afflicti:
tr: ελιθασθησαν επρισθησαν επειρασθησαν εν φονω μαχαιρας απεθανον περιηλθον εν μηλωταις εν αιγειοις δερμασιν υστερουμενοι θλιβομενοι κακουχουμενοι
kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

vulg: quibus dignus non erat mundus in solitudinibus errantes et montibus et speluncis et in cavernis terrae
clem: quibus dignus non erat mundus: in solitudinibus errantes, in montibus, in speluncis, et in cavernis terr.
tr: ων ουκ ην αξιος ο κοσμος εν ερημιαις πλανωμενοι και ορεσιν και σπηλαιοις και ταις οπαις της γης
kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

vulg: et hii omnes testimonio fidei probati non acceperunt repromissionem
clem: Et hi omnes testimonio fidei probati, non acceperunt repromissionem,
tr: και ουτοι παντες μαρτυρηθεντες δια της πιστεως ουκ εκομισαντο την επαγγελιαν
kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

vulg: Deo pro nobis melius aliquid providente ut ne sine nobis consummarentur
clem: Deo pro nobis melius aliquid providente, ut non sine nobis consummarentur.
tr: του θεου περι ημων κρειττον τι προβλεψαμενου ινα μη χωρις ημων τελειωθωσιν
kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

vulg: ideoque et nos tantam habentes inpositam nubem testium deponentes omne pondus et circumstans nos peccatum per patientiam curramus propositum nobis certamen
clem: Ideoque et nos tantam habentes impositam nubem testium, deponentes omne pondus, et circumstans nos peccatum, per patientiam curramus ad propositum nobis certamen:
tr: τοιγαρουν και ημεις τοσουτον εχοντες περικειμενον ημιν νεφος μαρτυρων ογκον αποθεμενοι παντα και την ευπεριστατον αμαρτιαν δι υπομονης τρεχωμεν τον προκειμενον ημιν αγωνα
kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

vulg: aspicientes in auctorem fidei et consummatorem Iesum qui pro proposito sibi gaudio sustinuit crucem confusione contempta atque in dextera sedis Dei sedit
clem: aspicientes in auctorem fidei, et consummatorem Jesum, qui proposito sibi gaudio sustinuit crucem, confusione contempta, atque in dextera sedis Dei sedet.
tr: αφορωντες εις τον της πιστεως αρχηγον και τελειωτην ιησουν ος αντι της προκειμενης αυτω χαρας υπεμεινεν σταυρον αισχυνης καταφρονησας εν δεξια τε του θρονου του θεου εκαθισεν
kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

vulg: recogitate enim eum qui talem sustinuit a peccatoribus adversum semet ipsos contradictionem ut ne fatigemini animis vestris deficientes
clem: Recogitate enim eum qui talem sustinuit a peccatoribus adversum semetipsum contradictionem: ut ne fatigemini, animis vestris deficientes.
tr: αναλογισασθε γαρ τον τοιαυτην υπομεμενηκοτα υπο των αμαρτωλων εις αυτον αντιλογιαν ινα μη καμητε ταις ψυχαις υμων εκλυομενοι
kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

vulg: nondum usque ad sanguinem restitistis adversus peccatum repugnantes
clem: Nondum enim usque ad sanguinem restitistis, adversus peccatum repugnantes:
tr: ουπω μεχρις αιματος αντικατεστητε προς την αμαρτιαν ανταγωνιζομενοι
kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

vulg: et obliti estis consolationis quae vobis tamquam filiis loquitur dicens fili mi noli neglegere disciplinam Domini neque fatigeris dum ab eo argueris
clem: et obliti estis consolationis, qu vobis tamquam filiis loquitur, dicens: Fili mi, noli negligere disciplinam Domini: neque fatigeris dum ab eo argueris.
tr: και εκλελησθε της παρακλησεως ητις υμιν ως υιοις διαλεγεται υιε μου μη ολιγωρει παιδειας κυριου μηδε εκλυου υπ αυτου ελεγχομενος
kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

vulg: quem enim diligit Dominus castigat flagellat autem omnem filium quem recipit
clem: Quem enim diligit Dominus, castigat: flagellat autem omnem filium, quem recipit.
tr: ον γαρ αγαπα κυριος παιδευει μαστιγοι δε παντα υιον ον παραδεχεται
kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

vulg: in disciplina perseverate tamquam filiis vobis offert Deus quis enim filius quem non corripit pater
clem: In disciplina perseverate. Tamquam filiis vobis offert se Deus: quis enim filius, quem non corripit pater?
tr: ει παιδειαν υπομενετε ως υιοις υμιν προσφερεται ο θεος τις γαρ εστιν υιος ον ου παιδευει πατηρ
kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

vulg: quod si extra disciplinam estis cuius participes facti sunt omnes ergo adulteri et non filii estis
clem: quod si extra disciplinam estis, cujus participes facti sunt omnes: ergo adulteri, et non filii estis.
tr: ει δε χωρις εστε παιδειας ης μετοχοι γεγονασιν παντες αρα νοθοι εστε και ουχ υιοι
kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

vulg: deinde patres quidem carnis nostrae habuimus eruditores et reverebamur non multo magis obtemperabimus Patri spirituum et vivemus
clem: Deinde patres quidem carnis nostr, eruditores habuimus, et reverebamur eos, non multo magis obtemperabimus Patri spirituum, et vivemus?
tr: ειτα τους μεν της σαρκος ημων πατερας ειχομεν παιδευτας και ενετρεπομεθα ου πολλω μαλλον υποταγησομεθα τω πατρι των πνευματων και ζησομεν
kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

vulg: et illi quidem in tempore paucorum dierum secundum voluntatem suam erudiebant nos hic autem ad id quod utile est in recipiendo sanctificationem eius
clem: Et illi quidem in tempore paucorum dierum, secundum voluntatem suam erudiebant nos: hic autem ad id quod utile est in recipiendo sanctificationem ejus.
tr: οι μεν γαρ προς ολιγας ημερας κατα το δοκουν αυτοις επαιδευον ο δε επι το συμφερον εις το μεταλαβειν της αγιοτητος αυτου
kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

vulg: omnis autem disciplina in praesenti quidem videtur non esse gaudii sed maeroris postea autem fructum pacatissimum exercitatis per eam reddit iustitiae
clem: Omnis autem disciplina in prsenti quidem videtur non esse gaudii, sed mroris: postea autem fructum pacatissimum exercitatis per eam, reddet justiti.
tr: πασα δε παιδεια προς μεν το παρον ου δοκει χαρας ειναι αλλα λυπης υστερον δε καρπον ειρηνικον τοις δι αυτης γεγυμνασμενοις αποδιδωσιν δικαιοσυνης
kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

vulg: propter quod remissas manus et soluta genua erigite
clem: Propter quod remissas manus, et soluta genua erigite,
tr: διο τας παρειμενας χειρας και τα παραλελυμενα γονατα ανορθωσατε
kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

vulg: et gressus rectos facite pedibus vestris ut non claudicans erret magis autem sanetur
clem: et gressus rectos facite pedibus vestris: ut non claudicans quis erret, magis autem sanetur.
tr: και τροχιας ορθας ποιησατε τοις ποσιν υμων ινα μη το χωλον εκτραπη ιαθη δε μαλλον
kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

vulg: pacem sequimini cum omnibus et sanctimoniam sine qua nemo videbit Dominum
clem: Pacem sequimini cum omnibus, et sanctimoniam, sine qua nemo videbit Deum:
tr: ειρηνην διωκετε μετα παντων και τον αγιασμον ου χωρις ουδεις οψεται τον κυριον
kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

vulg: contemplantes ne quis desit gratiae Dei ne qua radix amaritudinis sursum germinans inpediat et per illam inquinentur multi
clem: contemplantes nequis desit grati Dei: ne qua radix amaritudinis sursum germinans impediat, et per illam inquinentur multi.
tr: επισκοπουντες μη τις υστερων απο της χαριτος του θεου μη τις ριζα πικριας ανω φυουσα ενοχλη και δια ταυτης μιανθωσιν πολλοι
kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

vulg: ne quis fornicator aut profanus ut Esau qui propter unam escam vendidit primitiva sua
clem: Ne quis fornicator, aut profanus ut Esau: qui propter unam escam vendidit primitiva sua:
tr: μη τις πορνος η βεβηλος ως ησαυ ος αντι βρωσεως μιας απεδοτο τα πρωτοτοκια αυτου
kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

vulg: scitote enim quoniam et postea cupiens hereditare benedictionem reprobatus est non enim invenit paenitentiae locum quamquam cum lacrimis inquisisset eam
clem: scitote enim quoniam et postea cupiens hreditare benedictionem, reprobatus est: non enim invenit pnitenti locum, quamquam cum lacrimis inquisisset eam.
tr: ιστε γαρ οτι και μετεπειτα θελων κληρονομησαι την ευλογιαν απεδοκιμασθη μετανοιας γαρ τοπον ουχ ευρεν καιπερ μετα δακρυων εκζητησας αυτην
kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

vulg: non enim accessistis ad tractabilem et accensibilem ignem et turbinem et caliginem et procellam
clem: Non enim accessistis ad tractabilem montem, et accensibilem ignem, et turbinem, et caliginem, et procellam,
tr: ου γαρ προσεληλυθατε ψηλαφωμενω ορει και κεκαυμενω πυρι και γνοφω και σκοτω και θυελλη
kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

vulg: et tubae sonum et vocem verborum quam qui audierunt excusaverunt se ne eis fieret verbum
clem: et tub sonum, et vocem verborum, quam qui audierunt, excusaverunt se, ne eis fieret verbum.
tr: και σαλπιγγος ηχω και φωνη ρηματων ης οι ακουσαντες παρητησαντο μη προστεθηναι αυτοις λογον
kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

vulg: non enim portabant quod dicebatur et si bestia tetigerit montem lapidabitur
clem: Non enim portabant quod dicebatur: Et si bestia tetigerit montem, lapidabitur.
tr: ουκ εφερον γαρ το διαστελλομενον καν θηριον θιγη του ορους λιθοβοληθησεται η βολιδι κατατοξευθησεται
kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

vulg: et ita terribile erat quod videbatur Moses dixit exterritus sum et tremebundus
clem: Et ita terribile erat quod videbatur. Moyses dixit: Exterritus sum, et tremebundus.
tr: και ουτως φοβερον ην το φανταζομενον μωσης ειπεν εκφοβος ειμι και εντρομος
kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

vulg: sed accessistis ad Sion montem et civitatem Dei viventis Hierusalem caelestem et multorum milium angelorum frequentiae
clem: Sed accessistis ad Sion montem, et civitatem Dei viventis, Jerusalem clestem, et multorum millium angelorum frequentiam,
tr: αλλα προσεληλυθατε σιων ορει και πολει θεου ζωντος ιερουσαλημ επουρανιω και μυριασιν αγγελων
kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

vulg: et ecclesiam primitivorum qui conscripti sunt in caelis et iudicem omnium Deum et spiritus iustorum perfectorum
clem: et ecclesiam primitivorum, qui conscripti sunt in clis, et judicem omnium Deum, et spiritus justorum perfectorum,
tr: πανηγυρει και εκκλησια πρωτοτοκων εν ουρανοις απογεγραμμενων και κριτη θεω παντων και πνευμασιν δικαιων τετελειωμενων
kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

vulg: et testamenti novi mediatorem Iesum et sanguinis sparsionem melius loquentem quam Abel
clem: et testamenti novi mediatorem Jesum, et sanguinis aspersionem melius loquentem quam Abel.
tr: και διαθηκης νεας μεσιτη ιησου και αιματι ραντισμου κρειττονα λαλουντι παρα τον  το  αβελ
kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

vulg: videte ne recusetis loquentem si enim illi non effugerunt recusantes eum qui super terram loquebatur multo magis nos qui de caelis loquentem nobis avertimur
clem: Videte ne recusetis loquentem. Si enim illi non effugerunt, recusantes eum, qui super terram loquebatur: multo magis nos, qui de clis loquentem nobis avertimus.
tr: βλεπετε μη παραιτησησθε τον λαλουντα ει γαρ εκεινοι ουκ εφυγον τον επι της γης παραιτησαμενοι χρηματιζοντα πολλω μαλλον ημεις οι τον απ ουρανων αποστρεφομενοι
kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

vulg: cuius vox movit terram tunc modo autem repromittit dicens adhuc semel ego movebo non solum terram sed et caelum
clem: Cujus vox movit terram tunc: nunc autem repromittit, dicens: Adhuc semel, et ego movebo non solum terram, sed et clum.
tr: ου η φωνη την γην εσαλευσεν τοτε νυν δε επηγγελται λεγων ετι απαξ εγω σειω ου μονον την γην αλλα και τον ουρανον
kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

vulg: quod autem adhuc semel dicit declarat mobilium translationem tamquam factorum ut maneant ea quae sunt inmobilia
clem: Quod autem, Adhuc semel, dicit: declarat mobilium translationem tamquam factorum, ut maneant ea qu sunt immobilia.
tr: το δε ετι απαξ δηλοι των σαλευομενων την μεταθεσιν ως πεποιημενων ινα μεινη τα μη σαλευομενα
kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

vulg: itaque regnum inmobile suscipientes habemus gratiam per quam serviamus placentes Deo cum metu et reverentia
clem: Itaque regnum immobile suscipientes, habemus gratiam: per quam serviamus placentes Deo, cum metu et reverentia.
tr: διο βασιλειαν ασαλευτον παραλαμβανοντες εχωμεν χαριν δι ης λατρευωμεν ευαρεστως τω θεω μετα αιδους και ευλαβειας
kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

vulg: etenim Deus noster ignis consumens est
clem: Etenim Deus noster ignis consumens est.
tr: και γαρ ο θεος ημων πυρ καταναλισκον
kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.

vulg: caritas fraternitatis maneat
clem: Caritas fraternitatis maneat in vobis,
tr: η φιλαδελφια μενετω
kjv: Let brotherly love continue.

vulg: hospitalitatem nolite oblivisci per hanc enim latuerunt quidam angelis hospitio receptis
clem: et hospitalitatem nolite oblivisci: per hanc enim latuerunt quidam, angelis hospitio receptis.
tr: της φιλοξενιας μη επιλανθανεσθε δια ταυτης γαρ ελαθον τινες ξενισαντες αγγελους
kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

vulg: mementote vinctorum tamquam simul vincti et laborantium tamquam et ipsi in corpore morantes
clem: Mementote vinctorum, tamquam simul vincti: et laborantium, tamquam et ipsi in corpore morantes.
tr: μιμνησκεσθε των δεσμιων ως συνδεδεμενοι των κακουχουμενων ως και αυτοι οντες εν σωματι
kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

vulg: honorabile conubium in omnibus et torus inmaculatus fornicatores enim et adulteros iudicabit Deus
clem: Honorabile connubium in omnibus, et thorus immaculatus. Fornicatores enim, et adulteros judicabit Deus.
tr: τιμιος ο γαμος εν πασιν και η κοιτη αμιαντος πορνους δε και μοιχους κρινει ο θεος
kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

vulg: sint mores sine avaritia contenti praesentibus ipse enim dixit non te deseram neque derelinquam
clem: Sint mores sine avaritia, contenti prsentibus: ipse enim dixit: Non te deseram, neque derelinquam:
tr: αφιλαργυρος ο τροπος αρκουμενοι τοις παρουσιν αυτος γαρ ειρηκεν ου μη σε ανω ουδ ου μη σε εγκαταλιπω
kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

vulg: ita ut confidenter dicamus Dominus mihi adiutor non timebo quid faciat mihi homo
clem: ita ut confidenter dicamus: Dominus mihi adjutor: non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
tr: ωστε θαρρουντας ημας λεγειν κυριος εμοι βοηθος και ου φοβηθησομαι τι ποιησει μοι ανθρωπος
kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

vulg: mementote praepositorum vestrorum qui vobis locuti sunt verbum Dei quorum intuentes exitum conversationis imitamini fidem
clem: Mementote prpositorum vestrorum, qui vobis locuti sunt verbum Dei: quorum intuentes exitum conversationis, imitamini fidem.
tr: μνημονευετε των ηγουμενων υμων οιτινες ελαλησαν υμιν τον λογον του θεου ων αναθεωρουντες την εκβασιν της αναστροφης μιμεισθε την πιστιν
kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

vulg: Iesus Christus heri et hodie ipse et in saecula
clem: Jesus Christus heri, et hodie: ipse et in scula.
tr: ιησους χριστος χθες και σημερον ο αυτος και εις τους αιωνας
kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

vulg: doctrinis variis et peregrinis nolite abduci optimum enim est gratia stabiliri cor non escis quae non profuerunt ambulantibus in eis
clem: Doctrinis variis et peregrinis nolite abduci. Optimum est enim gratia stabilire cor, non escis: qu non profuerunt ambulantibus in eis.
tr: διδαχαις ποικιλαις και ξεναις μη περιφερεσθε καλον γαρ χαριτι βεβαιουσθαι την καρδιαν ου βρωμασιν εν οις ουκ ωφεληθησαν οι περιπατησαντες
kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

vulg: habemus altare de quo edere non habent potestatem qui tabernaculo deserviunt
clem: Habemus altare, de quo edere non habent potestatem, qui tabernaculo deserviunt.
tr: εχομεν θυσιαστηριον εξ ου φαγειν ουκ εχουσιν εξουσιαν οι τη σκηνη λατρευοντες
kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

vulg: quorum enim animalium infertur sanguis pro peccato in sancta per pontificem horum corpora cremantur extra castra
clem: Quorum enim animalium infertur sanguis pro peccato in Sancta per pontificem, horum corpora cremantur extra castra.
tr: ων γαρ εισφερεται ζωων το αιμα περι αμαρτιας εις τα αγια δια του αρχιερεως τουτων τα σωματα κατακαιεται εξω της παρεμβολης
kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

vulg: propter quod et Iesus ut sanctificaret per suum sanguinem populum extra portam passus est
clem: Propter quod et Jesus, ut sanctificaret per suum sanguinem populum, extra portam passus est.
tr: διο και ιησους ινα αγιαση δια του ιδιου αιματος τον λαον εξω της πυλης επαθεν
kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

vulg: exeamus igitur ad eum extra castra inproperium eius portantes
clem: Exeamus igitur ad eum extra castra, improperium ejus portantes.
tr: τοινυν εξερχωμεθα προς αυτον εξω της παρεμβολης τον ονειδισμον αυτου φεροντες
kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

vulg: non enim habemus hic manentem civitatem sed futuram inquirimus
clem: Non enim habemus hic manentem civitatem, sed futuram inquirimus.
tr: ου γαρ εχομεν ωδε μενουσαν πολιν αλλα την μελλουσαν επιζητουμεν
kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

vulg: per ipsum ergo offeramus hostiam laudis semper Deo id est fructum labiorum confitentium nomini eius
clem: Per ipsum ergo offeramus hostiam laudis semper Deo, id est, fructum labiorum confitentium nomini ejus.
tr: δι αυτου ουν αναφερωμεν θυσιαν αινεσεως διαπαντος  δια παντος  τω θεω τουτ εστιν καρπον χειλεων ομολογουντων τω ονοματι αυτου
kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

vulg: beneficientiae autem et communionis nolite oblivisci talibus enim hostiis promeretur Deus
clem: Beneficenti autem et communionis nolite oblivisci: talibus enim hostiis promeretur Deus.
tr: της δε ευποιιας και κοινωνιας μη επιλανθανεσθε τοιαυταις γαρ θυσιαις ευαρεστειται ο θεος
kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

vulg: oboedite praepositis vestris et subiacete eis ipsi enim pervigilant quasi rationem pro animabus vestris reddituri ut cum gaudio hoc faciant et non gementes hoc enim non expedit vobis
clem: Obedite prpositis vestris, et subjacete eis. Ipsi enim pervigilant quasi rationem pro animabus vestris reddituri, ut cum gaudio hoc faciant, et non gementes: hoc enim non expedit vobis.
tr: πειθεσθε τοις ηγουμενοις υμων και υπεικετε αυτοι γαρ αγρυπνουσιν υπερ των ψυχων υμων ως λογον αποδωσοντες ινα μετα χαρας τουτο ποιωσιν και μη στεναζοντες αλυσιτελες γαρ υμιν τουτο
kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

vulg: orate pro nobis confidimus enim quia bonam conscientiam habemus in omnibus bene volentes conversari
clem: Orate pro nobis: confidimus enim quia bonam conscientiam habemus in omnibus bene volentes conversari.
tr: προσευχεσθε περι ημων πεποιθαμεν γαρ οτι καλην συνειδησιν εχομεν εν πασιν καλως θελοντες αναστρεφεσθαι
kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

vulg: amplius autem deprecor vos hoc facere ut quo celerius restituar vobis
clem: Amplius autem deprecor vos hoc facere, quo celerius restituar vobis.
tr: περισσοτερως δε παρακαλω τουτο ποιησαι ινα ταχιον αποκατασταθω υμιν
kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

vulg: Deus autem pacis qui eduxit de mortuis pastorem magnum ovium in sanguine testamenti aeterni Dominum nostrum Iesum
clem: Deus autem pacis, qui eduxit de mortuis pastorem magnum ovium, in sanguine testamenti terni, Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
tr: ο δε θεος της ειρηνης ο αναγαγων εκ νεκρων τον ποιμενα των προβατων τον μεγαν εν αιματι διαθηκης αιωνιου τον κυριον ημων ιησουν
kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

vulg: aptet vos in omni bono ut faciatis voluntatem eius faciens in vobis quod placeat coram se per Iesum Christum cui gloria in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: aptet vos in omni bono, ut faciatis ejus voluntatem: faciens in vobis quod placeat coram se per Jesum Christum: cui est gloria in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: καταρτισαι υμας εν παντι εργω αγαθω εις το ποιησαι το θελημα αυτου ποιων εν υμιν το ευαρεστον ενωπιον αυτου δια ιησου χριστου ω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: rogo autem vos fratres sufferatis verbum solacii etenim perpaucis scripsi vobis
clem: Rogo autem vos fratres, ut sufferatis verbum solatii. Etenim perpaucis scripsi vobis.
tr: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι ανεχεσθε του λογου της παρακλησεως και γαρ δια βραχεων επεστειλα υμιν
kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

vulg: cognoscite fratrem nostrum Timotheum dimissum cum quo si celerius venerit videbo vos
clem: Cognoscite fratrem nostrum Timotheum dimissum: cum quo (si celerius venerit) videbo vos.
tr: γινωσκετε  τον αδελφον τιμοθεον απολελυμενον μεθ ου εαν ταχιον ερχηται οψομαι υμας
kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

vulg: salutate omnes praepositos vestros et omnes sanctos salutant vos de Italia
clem: Salutate omnes prpositos vestros, et omnes sanctos. Salutant vos de Italia fratres.
tr: ασπασασθε παντας τους ηγουμενους υμων και παντας τους αγιους ασπαζονται υμας οι απο της ιταλιας
kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

vulg: gratia cum omnibus vobis amen
clem: Gratia cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
tr: η χαρις μετα παντων υμων αμην [ προς εβραιους εγραφη απο της ιταλιας δια τιμοθεου]
kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen.
